chapters.name: Unit 1 Text A New Words

words.ex: He was shy during his adolescence.
words.ex_cn: 他在青春期时很害羞。
words.en: Adolescence is the period in a person's life when they develop from a child into an adult.

words.tr: adv. 不具名地；化名地；匿名地
words.ex: He posted the comment anonymously.
words.ex_cn: 他匿名发布了这条评论。
words.en: If something is done anonymously, it is done without the name of the person involved being known or made public.

words.tr: adj. 注意的；专心的；留心的；关心的
words.ex: The child is attentive in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子上课很专心。
words.en: If you are attentive, you are paying close attention to what is being said or done.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.ex: She is the belle of the ball.
words.ex_cn: 她是舞会上的美女。
words.en: A belle is a beautiful and charming woman, especially the most beautiful one at a particular event or in a particular group.

words.ex: Exercise can bolster your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的健康。
words.en: If you bolster something such as someone's confidence or courage, you increase it. A bolster is also a long, firm pillow.

words.tr:
n. 支撑物；支架；牙箍
v. 支撑；绷紧；紧靠；准备好
words.ex: The old bookshelf needs a brace to stay steady.
words.ex_cn: 旧书架需要一个支撑物来保持稳定。
words.en: To brace oneself means to prepare oneself for something difficult or unpleasant.

words.tr:
v. 撞；碰上；颠簸行进；
n. 碰撞；猛击；肿块；凸块；
words.ex: He bumped the table and spilled his drink.
words.ex_cn: 他撞到了桌子，打翻了饮料。
words.en: If you bump into something or someone, you accidentally hit them while you are moving.

words.tr: adj. 变化无常的；任性的
words.ex: He is capricious and changes his mind every day.
words.ex_cn: 他喜怒无常，每天都会改变主意。
words.en: Someone who is capricious often changes their mind unexpectedly.

words.ex: She is a comely girl with a sweet smile.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个面容姣好、带着甜美微笑的姑娘。
words.en: Pleasant to look at; attractive.

words.ex: The comparison of the two phones helped me decide.
words.ex_cn: 对这两部手机的比较帮助我做出了决定。
words.en: When you make a comparison, you consider two or more things and discover the differences or similarities between them.

words.ex: The trip is contingent on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行取决于天气情况。
words.en: A contingent event or situation depends on something else in order to happen or exist.

words.tr:
v. 嘎吱嘎吱地动；发嘎吱嘎吱声
n. 嘎吱声；艰难局面；危急情况
words.ex: The dog crunches the bone loudly.
words.ex_cn: 狗嘎吱嘎吱地咬着骨头。
words.en: To crunch means to chew noisily with your mouth open, or to make a loud noise like the sound of something being crushed. It can also refer to a critical point or situation, especially in financial contexts.

words.ex: The old man muttered a curse under his breath.
words.ex_cn: 老人低声嘟囔了一句诅咒。
words.en: A curse is a word or sentence that is used to wish evil or harm on someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 弯曲的；有曲线美的
words.ex: The road is curvy and hard to drive on.
words.ex_cn: 这条路是弯曲的，开车很难。
words.en: Having curves; attractively curved or shaped.

words.tr: v. 损毁…的外形；使变丑
words.ex: The accident disfigured his face.
words.ex_cn: 那次事故使他的脸变形了。
words.en: To disfigure someone or something means to spoil their appearance.

words.ex: He is downright lazy.
words.ex_cn: 他完全懒惰。
words.en: You use downright to emphasize that something is completely the case, especially when you are describing something bad or negative.

words.ex: The duckling swims behind its mother.
words.ex_cn: 小鸭子跟在妈妈后面游泳。
words.en: A duckling is a young duck.

words.ex: He is an emeritus professor at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的荣誉教授。
words.en: Emeritus is used to describe a professor, minister, or other professional who has retired but keeps an honorary title corresponding in some way to their former position.

words.ex: The bird evolved from a small dinosaur.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟由一种小型恐龙演变而来。
words.en: If something evolves or you evolve it, it gradually develops over a period of time into something different and usually more advanced.

words.ex: He uses this park exclusively for walking.
words.ex_cn: 他只在这个公园散步。
words.en: If you do something exclusively, you do it only in the way mentioned, and not in any other way.

words.tr:
n. 车费；费用；
v. 进展；成功（或不成功等）；
words.ex: The bus fare is two dollars.
words.ex_cn: 公交车费是两美元。
words.en: The fare is the amount of money that you pay for a journey that you make, for example, in a bus, train, or taxi.

words.tr: adj. 雀斑; 斑点; 晒斑; （使）生雀斑 v. 雀斑，斑点( freckle的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The freckled girl smiled in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 那个长满雀斑的女孩在阳光下微笑着。
words.en: Having small brownish spots on the skin, typically as a result of exposure to the sun.

words.ex: He was a gawky teenager with long, awkward limbs.
words.ex_cn: 他是个笨拙的少年，四肢又长又笨拙。
words.en: If you describe someone as gawky, you mean they are awkward and clumsy, often because they are young and have not yet grown into their body.

words.tr:
v. 闪烁；隐约闪现
n. 亮光；闪光
words.ex: The sun gleams on the water.
words.ex_cn: 阳光照在水面上，闪闪发亮。
words.en: A gleam is a small, bright light, especially one that shines for a short time.

words.ex: She wore traditional headgear for the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 她在仪式上戴了传统的头饰。
words.en: Headgear refers to any covering for the head, especially as part of a uniform or for protection.

words.tr: adj. 像家般舒适的；朴素的；
words.ex: The small cabin had a homely feel with soft blankets and a warm fire.
words.ex_cn: 这座小木屋有柔软的毛毯和温暖的火炉，感觉像家一样舒适。
words.en: If you describe something as homely, you mean that it is simple and plain, often in a way that is comforting. If you describe a person as homely, you mean that they are not very attractive.

words.ex: The painting showed a few small imperfections that the artist had missed.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画显示出艺术家忽略的几个小瑕疵。
words.en: An imperfection in something is a fault, weakness, or undesirable feature that it has.

words.ex: Babies have an innate ability to cry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿生来就有哭泣的能力。
words.en: An innate quality or ability is one that you were born with, not one you have learned.

words.tr:
n. 击败对手的一击；引人注目的人或物
adj. 击倒的；淘汰制的；引人注目的；迷人的
words.ex: He won the match with a knockout in the first round.
words.ex_cn: 他在第一回合以击倒获胜。
words.en: A knockout is a situation in boxing where one fighter is knocked down and unable to get up before the referee counts to ten, resulting in the other fighter winning the match. It can also refer to something that is extremely attractive or impressive.

words.tr:
v. 发射；发起；启动；
n. 发射；投掷；启动；
words.ex: They will launch a rocket tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将发射一枚火箭。
words.en: To launch something means to send it into the air, space, or water, especially with a lot of force or effort, or to start an activity, event, or project.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.tr: n. 翻新；重大改造；改善外观
words.ex: She gave her room a makeover last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 她上周末把房间彻底翻新了。
words.en: A makeover is a complete change of someone's appearance, often including their hair, makeup, and clothes, in order to improve their appearance.

words.ex: The makeup of the team includes students from five countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队的组成包括来自五个国家的学生。
words.en: Makeup refers to substances applied to the face to improve or alter the appearance, or the way in which something is composed or arranged.

words.ex: He obsesses over small mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他 obsesses 于微小的错误。
words.en: If something or someone obsesses you, you think or worry about them all the time and you cannot think about anything else.

words.tr: n. 露天历史剧；盛装游行（或庆典）；选美比赛
words.ex: The town held a pageant to show the history of the old kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇举办了一场露天历史剧，以展示古老王国的历史。
words.en: A pageant is a public entertainment consisting of a procession of people in elaborate, colorful costumes, or an outdoor performance of a historical scene.

words.ex: The quotient of 10 divided by 2 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 10除以2的商是5。
words.en: A quotient is the result you get by dividing one number by another.

words.ex: He worked hard and reaped the rewards.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，获得了回报。
words.en: To reap means to cut and gather a crop, or to obtain something, especially as a result of effort.

words.ex: The plane landed on the runway.
words.ex_cn: 飞机降落在跑道上。
words.en: A runway is a strip of land where aircraft take off and land.

words.tr:
n. 侦察兵；
v. 搜寻；
words.ex: The scout watched the enemy's movement quietly.
words.ex_cn: 侦察兵悄悄观察敌人的动向。
words.en: A scout is someone who is sent to an area of countryside to find out the position of an enemy or to search for a suitable place for a military camp.

words.tr: v. 详细检查；仔细察看
words.ex: The teacher scrutinizes every student's homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师仔细检查每位学生的作业。
words.en: If you scrutinize something, you examine it very carefully, often to find out some information from it or about it.

words.ex: He did a self-appraisal before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议前做了自我评估。
words.en: Self-appraisal is the process of evaluating one's own performance or abilities.

words.ex: His self-perception affects how he talks to others.
words.ex_cn: 他的自我认知影响了他与他人的交流方式。
words.en: The way in which one views oneself; self-image.

words.tr: adj. 破旧的；肮脏破烂的；衣衫褴褛的
words.ex: He wore a shabby coat to school.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件破旧的外套去学校。
words.en: If you describe something as shabby, you mean that it looks old and is in poor condition.

words.tr:
v. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
n. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
words.ex: They stroll in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们晚饭后在公园里闲逛。
words.en: If you stroll somewhere, you walk there in a slow, relaxed way.

words.tr: adj. 下意识的；潜意识的；
words.ex: The ad used subliminal messages to influence buyers.
words.ex_cn: 这则广告使用了下意识的信息来影响买家。
words.en: Subliminal refers to something that is below the threshold of sensation or consciousness; it is perceived by or affecting someone's mind without their being aware of it.

words.ex: He left the party, and subsequently went home.
words.ex_cn: 他离开了派对，随后回家了。
words.en: If something happens subsequently, it happens after something else.

words.ex: The difference between the two colors is subtle.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色之间的区别很微妙。
words.en: Something that is subtle is not immediately obvious or noticeable, but is rather indirect or understated.

words.ex: Children are susceptible to colds.
words.ex_cn: 孩子容易感冒。
words.en: If you are susceptible to something or someone, you are very likely to be influenced by them.

words.ex: A white swan swam quietly on the lake.
words.ex_cn: 一只白天鹅静静地在湖上游泳。
words.en: A swan is a large, white bird with a long neck that lives on rivers and lakes.

chapters.name: Unit 1 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He fixates on small mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他专注于小错误。
words.en: If you fixate on something, you think about it so much that you are unable to consider or think about anything else.

words.ex: He compares his score with his friend's score.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的分数和朋友的分数做比较。
words.en: To examine or look for the difference between two or more things.

words.tr:
v. 辩论；争论
n. 辩论；争论
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: A debate is a discussion about a subject on which people have different views.

words.tr: phrase. v. 把某人打扮得花枝招展；精心装扮某人
words.ex: She will doll her sister up for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她会为妹妹打扮得漂漂亮亮去参加派对。
words.en: To dress someone up in a fancy or elaborate way.

words.tr: phrase. 打扮自己；整理仪容；使自己显得更整洁或更有吸引力
words.ex: She likes to fix herself up before going to a party.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢在去派对前打扮自己。
words.en: To make oneself look neat and attractive, especially by arranging one's clothes and hair.

words.ex: Don't get in the way when others are working.
words.ex_cn: 当别人工作时，不要挡道。
words.en: If something or someone gets in the way, they prevent you from doing something or make it more difficult for you to do it.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 妨碍；阻挡；干扰
words.ex: Don't let fear get in the way of your dreams.
words.ex_cn: 别让恐惧阻碍你的梦想。
words.en: To prevent someone from doing something or prevent something from happening.

words.tr: phrase. 以赞许的方式；从有利的角度；以正面的形象呈现
words.ex: The movie shows him in a favorable light.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影把他描绘得很有利。
words.en: To present someone or something in a way that makes them seem good or positive.

words.ex: He likes cats. In contrast, she prefers dogs.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢猫。相比之下，她更喜欢狗。
words.en: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first

words.tr: phrase. 放开；松手；释放；放弃
words.ex: You need to let go of the past and move forward.
words.ex_cn: 你需要放下过去，继续前进。
words.en: To release or stop holding something or someone.

words.ex: The candles light up the room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛点亮了房间。
words.en: To make something bright or to start to burn.

words.tr: phrase. 签约参加工作；签约雇用；报名
words.ex: He signed up for a job at the local factory.
words.ex_cn: 他签约参加了当地工厂的工作。
words.en: To agree to become involved in an organized activity or to join a group or organization.

words.tr: phrase. v. 集中注意力于；瞄准；精准定位（某事物或目标）
words.ex: The detective will zero in on the main suspect.
words.ex_cn: 侦探将集中注意力于主要嫌疑人。
words.en: To direct all one's attention or efforts towards a particular target or goal.

chapters.name: Unit 1 Text B New Words

words.ex: The blocker stopped the ball with his hand.
words.ex_cn: 防守队员用手挡住了球。
words.en: A blocker is someone or something that prevents movement or progress.

words.tr:
n. 监狱；牢房；叮当作响声
v. （使）发出叮当声
words.ex: The glasses clinked when they toasted.
words.ex_cn: 当他们碰杯时，玻璃杯发出了叮当声。
words.en: To make or cause to make a light, sharp, ringing sound; a light, sharp, ringing sound.

words.ex: The completion of the project took three months.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的完成花了三个月。
words.en: The act of finishing or making something whole or perfect.

words.tr:
n. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
v. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
words.ex: The flight had a delay because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 由于风暴，航班推迟了。
words.en: If you delay doing something, you do not do it immediately or at the planned or expected time, but you leave it until later.

words.tr:
n. 尽力；尝试；
v. 尽力；奋力；
words.ex: His endeavor to finish the project took all his energy.
words.ex_cn: 他为完成这个项目付出了全部努力。
words.en: An endeavor is an attempt to do something, especially something new or original.

words.ex: He exhale slowly after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后慢慢呼出气。
words.en: To exhale means to breathe out air from your lungs.

words.ex: He extinguished the fire with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水把火扑灭了。
words.en: To extinguish a fire or a light means to stop it burning or shining.

words.ex: He frets about his exam results.
words.ex_cn: 他为考试成绩感到烦躁不安。
words.en: If you fret about something, you worry about it.

words.tr:
v. 钩住；拴住；急拉；搭便车
n. 故障；障碍；勾住；急拉
words.ex: The hook hitched the rope to the tree.
words.ex_cn: 钩子钩住了系在树上的绳子。
words.en: If you hitch, or hitch a ride, you hitchhike. If you hitch something to something else, you fasten it there.

words.ex: He used a match to ignite the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他用火柴点燃了火。
words.en: If you ignite something or if it ignites, it starts burning or explodes.

words.ex: The poem uses vivid imagery to describe the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗用生动的意象来描述日落。
words.en: Imagery consists of the elements in a poem or other literary work that appeal to the senses, especially sight.

words.ex: The doctor made a small incision to remove the tumor.
words.ex_cn: 医生做了一个小切口来切除肿瘤。
words.en: An incision is a cut that is made in someone's body during surgery.

words.tr: adj. 鼓舞人心的；给予灵感的；
words.ex: Her speech was inspirational and made everyone feel hopeful.
words.ex_cn: 她的演讲鼓舞人心，让每个人都感到充满希望。
words.en: Something that is inspirational provides encouragement or new ideas for what you should do.

words.tr: n. （足球）开球；（社会集会等）开始
words.ex: The kick-off is at 7 p.m. tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 开场时间是明天晚上7点。
words.en: The kick-off is the start of a football game or other event, marked by the first kick of the ball.

words.tr:
adj. 巨大的；强大的；
adv. 非常；
words.ex: The mighty river flows through the valley.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的河流流经山谷。
words.en: Possessing great power, strength, or force; formidable.

words.ex: The clock strikes precisely at noon.
words.ex_cn: 钟恰好在正午敲响。
words.en: In a precise manner; exactly.

words.ex: He is a pro player in esports.
words.ex_cn: 他是电子竞技的专业选手。
words.en: A pro is someone who is professional in a particular activity or sport, or someone who supports a particular idea or course of action.

words.ex: The actors had a rehearsal before the play.
words.ex_cn: 演出前，演员们进行了一次排练。
words.en: A rehearsal of a play, dance, or piece of music is a practice of it in preparation for a performance.

words.ex: The actors rehearse their lines every evening.
words.ex_cn: 演员们每天晚上排练他们的台词。
words.en: To rehearse means to practice a play, piece of music, or other work for later public performance.

words.ex: He is a rookie in the basketball team.
words.ex_cn: 他是篮球队的新手。
words.en: A rookie is someone who has just started a particular job or activity and has very little experience.

words.tr: v. 射击；拍摄（电影）；疾驰；“shoot”的过去式和过去分词； n. 照片；射击；射门；
words.ex: He shot the target with his gun.
words.ex_cn: 他用枪射击了目标。
words.en: A shot is an act of shooting a gun, or the sound that this makes. It can also refer to an attempt to do something, a photograph, or an injection.

words.ex: The temperature rose steadily throughout the day.
words.ex_cn: 白天温度稳定地上升。
words.en: If something happens or changes steadily, it happens or changes in a regular way without interruption.

words.tr:
n. 压力；（动植物的）品种；
v. 竭力；
words.ex: The job gave him a lot of strain.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作给他带来了很大的压力。
words.en: To strain means to make a great effort to do something, to pull or stretch something tightly, or to injure a muscle by stretching it too much.

words.tr:
v. 补充；
n. 补充物；附加费；
words.ex: He supplements his income by teaching part-time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职教学来补充收入。
words.en: A supplement is something that is added to something else in order to make it complete or better.

words.tr:
n. 缝线；缝合处
v. 缝合（伤口）
words.ex: The doctor used a suture to close the wound.
words.ex_cn: 医生用缝合线缝合了伤口。
words.en: A suture is a stitch or row of stitches holding together the edges of a wound or surgical incision.

words.ex: He will tackle the problem tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会处理这个问题。
words.en: If you tackle a problem or task, you deal with it in a determined way. In sports such as football and rugby, a tackle is an act of trying to take the ball from a player on the other team.

words.ex: The ball followed a smooth trajectory.
words.ex_cn: 球沿着一条平滑的轨迹飞行。
words.en: The path followed by a projectile flying or an object moving under the action of given forces.

words.ex: He was an unheralded artist who painted quietly for years.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位被埋没的艺术家，多年来默默作画。
words.en: If something is unheralded, it happens without any warning or without being announced in advance.

words.tr: n. 可视化；视觉化；形象化
words.ex: He uses visualization to understand the data.
words.ex_cn: 他使用可视化来理解数据。
words.en: Visualization is the process of making something able to be seen or easily imagined.

words.tr: v. 使可见；使形象化；设想；
words.ex: He uses maps to visualize the data.
words.ex_cn: 他使用地图来使数据可见。
words.en: If you visualize something, you imagine what it is like by forming a mental picture of it.

chapters.name: Unit 1 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He tried to fake out the defender with a quick move.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用一个快速动作骗过防守队员。
words.en: To deceive someone by making them believe something that is not true.

words.ex: He does ten push-ups every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做十个俯卧撑。
words.en: A push-up is a physical exercise performed in a prone position by raising and lowering the body using the arms.

words.ex: He learned English and put it to use in his job.
words.ex_cn: 他学了英语，并在工作中加以运用。
words.en: To use something for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 坚信；极为信赖；发誓效忠于
words.ex: I swear by this brand of toothpaste.
words.ex_cn: 我坚信这个品牌的牙膏。
words.en: If you swear by something, you believe that it is very effective and you always use it or recommend it to others.

words.tr: phrase. 使变为现实；实现（某事）
words.ex: Her dream will turn into reality next year.
words.ex_cn: 她的梦想明年将变为现实。
words.en: To make something that was previously only imagined or planned actually happen or exist.

chapters.name: Unit 2 Text A New Words

words.ex: She showed great affection for her little dog.
words.ex_cn: 她对她的小狗非常钟爱。
words.en: A feeling of liking and caring for someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 攻击性的；有进取心的；侵略性的；
words.ex: The dog showed aggressive behavior toward strangers.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗对陌生人表现出攻击性行为。
words.en: An aggressive person or animal has a quality of anger and determination that makes them ready to attack others.

words.tr:
adj. 交替的；轮流的；间隔的；
v. （使）交替；（使）轮流；
words.ex: We take alternate days off work.
words.ex_cn: 我们隔天休息一次。
words.en: If something alternates between two things, it repeatedly changes from one to the other and back again.

words.ex: His altruism made him donate all his money to the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他的利他主义让他把所有钱捐给了穷人。
words.en: Altruism is the belief in or practice of disinterested and selfless concern for the well-being of others.

words.ex: He is an anti-vivisectionist who opposes animal testing.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位反对动物实验的反活体解剖者。
words.en: An anti-vivisectionist is a person who is opposed to vivisection, the practice of performing operations on live animals for the purpose of experimentation or scientific research.

words.tr: n. 繁殖；饲养； v. “breed”的现在分词；
words.ex: The farm focuses on cattle breeding.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场专注于牛的繁殖。
words.en: The process of producing animals or plants by sexual reproduction, or the process of raising animals or plants in controlled conditions.

words.ex: The captive man sat quietly in his cell.
words.ex_cn: 那个被监禁的人安静地坐在牢房里。
words.en: A captive is someone who is being kept as a prisoner or in a confined space, or something that is held or confined.

words.ex: The lion lived in captivity for ten years.
words.ex_cn: 这只狮子被关押了十年。
words.en: The state of being imprisoned or confined.

words.tr:
n. 全体演员；
v. 投掷；扔；投射；
words.ex: The cast of the play performed very well.
words.ex_cn: 这部剧的全体演员表演得非常好。
words.en: To cast something means to throw it forcefully in a particular direction.

words.ex: The chimpanzee is eating a banana.
words.ex_cn: 这只黑猩猩正在吃一根香蕉。
words.en: A chimpanzee is a great ape native to the forest and savannah of tropical Africa. It is known for its intelligence, use of tools, and complex social structures.

words.ex: She showed compassion for the homeless man.
words.ex_cn: 她对那个无家可归的人表示同情。
words.en: Compassion is a feeling of pity, sympathy, and understanding for someone who is suffering.

words.ex: The condor flies high above the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 秃鹰在群山之上翱翔。
words.en: A condor is a very large bird of prey that lives in the mountains of South America and California.

words.tr: n. 自然环境保护主义者
words.ex: The conservationist protects wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 这位环保主义者保护野生动物。
words.en: A conservationist is someone who works to protect the environment, especially natural resources and wildlife.

words.ex: The forest is a healthy ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是一个健康的生态系统。
words.en: An ecosystem is a complex network or interconnected system, especially one that involves a community of living organisms in conjunction with their environment.

words.ex: This is an evolutionary change in the species.
words.ex_cn: 这是该物种的一种进化的改变。
words.en: Relating to or denoting processes of development or growth, especially in a biological context.

words.tr:
adj. 爆炸的；
n. 炸药；
words.ex: The explosive material was handled with care.
words.ex_cn: 爆炸性材料被小心地处理。
words.en: An explosive substance is capable of causing an explosion. It can also refer to something that is likely to cause an outburst or a sudden increase in activity or emotion.

words.tr: adv. 爆发地，引起爆炸地
words.ex: The firework exploded explosively in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 烟花在夜空中爆炸般地绽放。
words.en: In a manner that is likely to explode or cause an explosion; suddenly and violently.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.tr: adj. 在农场自由放养的（鸡）
words.ex: The chickens are free-range and eat grass.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸡是散养的，吃草。
words.en: Free-range is used to describe a method of farming where animals are allowed to roam and forage outdoors rather than being confined in an enclosure for 24 hours each day.

words.ex: He showed humility after winning the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他在赢得奖品后表现出了谦逊。
words.en: Humility is the quality of being humble and not thinking that you are better than other people.

words.ex: The fallen tree impeded the car's path.
words.ex_cn: 倒下的树阻碍了汽车的前进。
words.en: To impede something means to make its movement, development, or progress difficult.

words.tr: v. 把…强加给；使遭受；使承受
words.ex: The storm inflicted heavy damage on the village.
words.ex_cn: 风暴给村庄造成了严重破坏。
words.en: If you inflict something unpleasant on someone, you make them suffer it.

words.ex: He inherited a house from his father.
words.ex_cn: 他从父亲那里继承了一所房子。
words.en: If you inherit something such as a trait, characteristic, or quality, you are born with it, because your parents or ancestors had it. If you inherit money or property, you receive it from someone who has died.

words.ex: The cat made an instinctive jump to avoid the dog.
words.ex_cn: 猫本能地跳开以躲避狗。
words.en: An instinctive feeling, action, or idea is one that you have or do without thinking or reasoning.

words.ex: His intellect helps him solve difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他的智力帮助他解决难题。
words.en: The ability to understand and think in a logical way about things.

words.ex: The interconnectedness of nature is clear in forests.
words.ex_cn: 自然的相互联系在森林中很明显。
words.en: The state of being connected with each other.

words.ex: Methane is a gas that comes from cows and landfills.
words.ex_cn: 甲烷是一种来自牛和垃圾填埋场的气体。
words.en: A colorless, odorless flammable gas which is the main constituent of natural gas. It is the simplest member of the alkane series of hydrocarbons.

words.ex: Monkeys and apes are primates.
words.ex_cn: 猴子和猿类是灵长类动物。
words.en: A primate is a member of the most developed and intelligent group of mammals, which includes humans, apes, and monkeys. In a religious context, a primate can also refer to the chief bishop or archbishop in a province or country.

words.tr: n. 灵长类动物学家（primatology 的变形）
words.ex: The primatologist spent years studying the behavior of chimpanzees in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 这位灵长类动物学家花了数年时间研究野生黑猩猩的行为。
words.en: A primatologist is a scientist who studies primates, which include monkeys, apes, and humans.

words.tr: adj. 患狂犬病的；狂暴的；疯狂的
words.ex: The rabid dog ran wildly through the street.
words.ex_cn: 那只狂犬在街上狂奔。
words.en: If you describe someone as rabid, you mean that they have very strong and unreasonable opinions or beliefs about a subject, especially in politics.

words.ex: He felt resentment after being ignored by his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他被朋友忽视后感到怨恨。
words.en: Resentment is a feeling of anger or bitterness about something that you believe is unfair.

words.tr: adj. 有知觉的；有感觉力的；
words.ex: The robot became sentient and could feel pain.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器人变得有知觉，能够感受到疼痛。
words.en: A sentient being is capable of perception or feeling.

words.tr: adj. （尤指门票等）全部预售完的
words.ex: The concert tickets were sold-out in one hour.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会的票在一个小时内就售罄了。
words.en: If a performance, sports event, or other entertainment is sold out, all the tickets for it have been sold.

words.tr:
adj. 塞满的； 充满的；饱的
v. 塞；填充；“stuff”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The box was stuffed with old clothes.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子里塞满了旧衣服。
words.en: Filled tightly with something.

words.ex: The movie was thought-provoking and made me think deeply.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影发人深省，让我深思。
words.en: If something is thought-provoking, it makes you think seriously about a particular issue or question.

words.tr:
n. 酷刑；拷打
v. 拷打；折磨
words.ex: The prisoner suffered from torture during the war.
words.ex_cn: 这名囚犯在战争期间遭受了酷刑。
words.en: Torture is the act of deliberately inflicting severe physical or psychological pain on someone, typically to extract information or a confession, or as a punishment.

words.tr: adj. 意料之外的；未预见到的；
words.ex: The storm caused unforeseen damage to the town.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴给小镇造成了意料之外的破坏。
words.en: If something is unforeseen, it was not expected to happen or known about beforehand.

words.tr:
n. 素食者；食草动物；
adj. 素食者的；素菜的；
words.ex: He is a vegetarian and doesn't eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名素食者，不吃肉。
words.en: A vegetarian is someone who does not eat meat or fish, and sometimes other animal products, especially for moral, religious, or health reasons.

chapters.name: Unit 2 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 作为最后的手段；在别无选择时
words.ex: We will use force only as a last resort.
words.ex_cn: 我们只会在万不得已的情况下使用武力。
words.en: If you do something as a last resort, you do it because you can find no other way of getting out of a difficult situation or of solving a problem.

words.tr: 短语. 通常如此；情况就是这样；正如通常的情况一样
words.ex: He likes coffee, as is the case with his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，他的弟弟也是如此。
words.en: Used to indicate that a situation is the same as one that has just been mentioned.

words.tr: phrase. 状况好转的；经济状况好的
words.ex: He is better off staying home instead of going out in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他待在家里比在雨天外出更好。
words.en: If you are better off, you are in a better situation, usually because you have more money.

words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决困难的数学问题。
words.en: To have the ability, power, or skill to do something.

words.ex_cn: 他赞成多吃蔬菜。
words.en: To support or agree with a particular idea, plan, or person.

words.ex: A problem came up during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议期间发生了一个问题。
words.en: To arise or occur, especially unexpectedly or as a subject of discussion.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 接近某人；走到某人面前
words.ex: He came up to me and asked for help.
words.ex_cn: 他走过来找我帮忙。
words.en: To approach someone, especially in order to speak to them.

words.tr: phrase. 尽自己的一份力量；做自己该做的事
words.ex: Everyone can do one's bit to help the environment.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都可以尽自己的一份力来帮助环境。
words.en: To do one's bit means to contribute one's share of effort towards a common goal.

words.tr: phrase. （使）组合在一起，（使）吻合，协调搭配
words.ex: The puzzle pieces fit together easily.
words.ex_cn: 这些拼图块很容易拼合在一起。
words.en: To fit together means to combine or arrange parts or elements in a way that they form a coherent or functional whole.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持下去；别放弃（用于鼓励他人在困难中保持毅力）
words.ex: Just hang in there; things will get better.
words.ex_cn: 坚持下去；情况会好转的。
words.en: If you tell someone to hang in there or to hang on in there, you are encouraging them to keep trying to do something and not to give up even though it might be difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 要紧；区别对待；有影响；起（重要）作用
words.ex: Volunteering can make a difference in your community.
words.ex_cn: 志愿服务能为你的社区带来改变。
words.en: If something makes a difference, it affects someone or something positively, especially in a noticeable or important way.

words.tr: phrase. 在途中；在路上；到处奔走
words.ex: She spends most of her time on the road, traveling for work.
words.ex_cn: 她大部分时间都在路上，为工作出差。
words.en: Traveling or touring, especially as part of a band or sports team.

words.tr: phrase. 最终结果；底线；关键点；净收益
words.ex: The bottom line is that we need to save money.
words.ex_cn: 最终结果是我们需要省钱。
words.en: The bottom line is the final result or the most important aspect of a situation or problem.

words.tr: phrase. 三思而行；仔细考虑后再做决定
words.ex: He thinks twice before he buys a car.
words.ex_cn: 他在买车之前会三思。
words.en: To consider something more carefully before making a decision.

words.ex: To some extent, he likes the new job.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他喜欢这份新工作。
words.en: To some extent means to a certain degree or in a certain measure, but not completely.

words.tr: phrase. 处境更差的；更贫困的；情况更糟的
words.ex: He is worse off without his job.
words.ex_cn: 他没了工作后情况更糟了。
words.en: In a less favorable or advantageous position, especially in terms of financial or social status.

chapters.name: Unit 2 Text B New Words

words.tr:
n. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
v. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
words.ex: The abuse of power led to many problems.
words.ex_cn: 权力的滥用导致了许多问题。
words.en: Abuse is the improper usage or treatment of a thing, often to unfairly or improperly gain benefit. Abuse can come in many forms, such as physical or verbal maltreatment, injury, assault, violation, rape, unjust practices, crimes, or other types of aggression.

words.tr: n. 喜爱；类同；密切关系；亲和力
words.ex: She has an affinity for painting.
words.ex_cn: 她喜爱绘画。
words.en: A natural liking for or attraction to someone or something.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.tr: v. 以朋友态度对待；帮助
words.ex: He decided to befriend the new student.
words.ex_cn: 他决定结交那个新生。
words.en: To befriend someone means to act as a friend to them by offering help, support, or companionship.

words.ex: Clean water is a boon to the village.
words.ex_cn: 干净的水对这个村庄是有益的。
words.en: A boon is something that is very helpful and improves the quality of life.

words.tr:
adj. 浅黄色的；黄皮革制的
n. 浅黄色；浅黄色皮革；爱好者
v. 用软布擦亮
words.ex: The buff walls looked warm in the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 浅黄色的墙壁在阳光下显得温暖。
words.en: A buff is a person who is very interested in and knowledgeable about a particular subject.

words.tr:
n. 爱抚；抚摸；吻
v. 爱抚；抚摸；吻
words.ex: Her caress made the baby feel safe.
words.ex_cn: 她的爱抚让婴儿感到安全。
words.en: A caress is a gentle, loving touch or gesture, often given to show affection.

words.ex: The caretaker cleans the building every day.
words.ex_cn: 看管人每天打扫这座大楼。
words.en: A caretaker is a person whose job is to look after a large building such as a school or a block of flats or apartments, and deal with small repairs to it.

words.ex: The children loved the circus with clowns and elephants.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢有小丑和大象的马戏团。
words.en: A circus is a group of performers that include clowns, acrobats, and trained animals, who travel to different places to entertain people.

words.ex: His dog gave him constant companionship.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗给了他不断的陪伴。
words.en: the state of being with someone or having someone to spend time with

words.tr: n. 郊狼；丛林狼；草原狼；
words.ex: The coyote ran across the desert at night.
words.ex_cn: 那只郊狼在夜晚跑过沙漠。
words.en: A coyote is a wild dog that looks like a wolf and lives in North America.

words.ex: She is currently working at a hospital.
words.ex_cn: 她目前正在一家医院工作。
words.en: at the present time

words.tr: v. 投入；献身；“devote”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 全心全意的；投入的；
words.ex: He devoted all his time to helping his students.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有时间都投入到了帮助学生上。
words.en: If you are devoted to something, you care about it a lot and are very enthusiastic about it.

words.ex: His devotion to his family is obvious.
words.ex_cn: 他对家庭的献身显而易见。
words.en: Devotion is great love, affection, or admiration for someone or something.

words.ex: He kept his dignity even when he was poor.
words.ex_cn: 即使他很穷，他依然保持尊严。
words.en: Dignity is the quality of being worthy of honor or respect.

words.ex: There is a disparity in pay between men and women.
words.ex_cn: 男女之间的工资存在差异。
words.en: A disparity between two or more things is a noticeable difference between them.

words.ex: The hospital received a donation of books.
words.ex_cn: 医院收到了一批书籍捐赠。
words.en: A donation is a gift which is given to a charity or other organization.

words.ex: The weather is exceedingly cold today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气极其寒冷。
words.en: To a very great degree; extremely.

words.ex: The cat has a fluffy tail.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫有一条蓬松的尾巴。
words.en: Something that is fluffy is soft and light, with many small, loose pieces or parts.

words.ex: The old man walked with a slow gait.
words.ex_cn: 老人走路步伐缓慢。
words.en: A person's manner of walking.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.ex: The ship docked at the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbor is a place on the coast where ships may moor in shelter, especially one protected from rough water by piers, jetties, and other artificial structures.

words.ex: The injured man was immobile after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，这名受伤的人无法移动。
words.en: If something is immobile, it is not moving or cannot move.

words.ex: His infirmity made it hard to walk.
words.ex_cn: 他的虚弱使他走路困难。
words.en: An infirmity is a physical or mental weakness.

words.tr:
n. 亲属；血缘关系
adj. 同源的；类似的
words.ex: He visited his kindred during the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 他在假期里探望了他的亲属。
words.en: If two people or things are kindred, they are similar in some way, often because they are related.

words.tr: n. 寿命；使用寿命；生命期；
words.ex: The lifespan of a housefly is only a few weeks.
words.ex_cn: 家蝇的寿命只有几周。
words.en: The length of time for which a person or animal lives or a thing functions.

words.tr: adv. 笨拙地，动作迟缓地
words.ex: He walked lumberingly after his injury.
words.ex_cn: 他受伤后走路笨拙缓慢。
words.en: Moving in a slow, heavy, awkward way.

words.tr:
adv. 彻底地；立刻地；
adj. 完全的；彻底的；
words.ex: He refused the offer outright.
words.ex_cn: 他彻底拒绝了这个提议。
words.en: If something is done outright, it is done completely and without any hesitation or attempt to hide it.

words.ex: She sings passionately in front of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 她在人群前热烈地唱歌。
words.en: If you are passionate about something, you have very strong feelings about it or a strong belief in it.

words.ex: The playful puppy chased its tail.
words.ex_cn: 那只爱玩耍的小狗追着自己的尾巴跑。
words.en: Someone who is playful is full of fun and likes to play.

words.ex: The proceeds from the sale went to charity.
words.ex_cn: 销售所得收益捐给了慈善机构。
words.en: Proceeds are the money that is received from a particular event or activity, especially when it is used for a specific purpose.

words.ex: He needs time for recovery after the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他手术后需要时间恢复。
words.en: The process of becoming well again after an illness or injury, or the process of returning to a normal condition after a period of difficulty.

words.ex: He regained his strength after rest.
words.ex_cn: 他休息后恢复了体力。
words.en: If you regain something that you have lost, you get it back again.

words.ex: After a short break, he resumed his work.
words.ex_cn: 短暂休息后，他继续工作。
words.en: If you resume an activity or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after an interruption.

words.ex: The retriever brings back the ball for its owner.
words.ex_cn: 寻回犬为主人把球叼回来。
words.en: A retriever is a type of dog that is trained to bring back game that has been shot by a hunter.

words.tr: n. 避难所；庇护所；庇护；
words.ex: The birds found sanctuary in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟在森林里找到了避难所。
words.en: A sanctuary is a place where people or animals are protected from danger or trouble.

words.ex: The shepherd walks with his sheep every morning.
words.ex_cn: 牧羊人每天早上都带着他的羊走路。
words.en: A shepherd is a person whose job is to look after sheep. As a verb, it means to guide or direct someone or something in a particular direction.

words.ex: The stray dog wandered into the backyard.
words.ex_cn: 这只走失的狗走进了后院。
words.en: If someone or something strays, they wander away from where they are supposed to be.

words.ex: The therapeutic massage helped her relax.
words.ex_cn: 这种治疗性的按摩帮助她放松了。
words.en: If something is therapeutic, it helps you to relax or to feel better about things, especially if you have been feeling worried or upset.

words.ex: The unresolved problem caused much stress.
words.ex_cn: 这个未解决的问题引起了很大的压力。
words.en: If a problem or difficulty is unresolved, no satisfactory solution has been found to it.

words.tr: n. 举办地点；（比赛）地点；会场；
words.ex: The concert will be held at a new venue.
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会将在一个新的举办地点举行。
words.en: A place where an event or meeting is held, such as a concert hall or conference center.

words.ex: He kept a vigil by his sick mother.
words.ex_cn: 他守在生病的母亲旁边。
words.en: A vigil is a period of staying awake, especially at night, in order to be with someone who is ill or to make a protest, or a period of time when people stay awake, especially at night, to pray.

words.tr:
v. 摇摆；摇动
n. 摇摆；爱说笑的人
words.ex: The dog wagged its tail happily.
words.ex_cn: 狗开心地摇着尾巴。
words.en: If a dog wags its tail, it moves its tail from side to side, often because it is happy or excited.

chapters.name: Unit 2 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 应……的请求；在……的要求下
words.ex: He left the job at the request of his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他应老板的要求离开了这份工作。
words.en: If something is done at the request of someone, it is done because they have asked for it to be done.

words.ex: He ran fast to catch up with his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便追上他的朋友。
words.en: To reach someone or something that is ahead of you, or to make up for lost time or progress.

words.tr: 短语动词. 归某人所有；落入某人手中
words.ex: The old watch came into his possession after his grandfather died.
words.ex_cn: 祖父去世后，这块旧表到了他手中。
words.en: To become owned by someone.

words.tr: phrase. 高度尊重；对……非常敬重
words.ex: People hold teachers in high regard for their hard work.
words.ex_cn: 人们非常尊重教师的辛勤工作。
words.en: To hold someone or something in high regard means to have a lot of respect or admiration for them.

words.ex: They have music in common.
words.ex_cn: 他们有共同的爱好是音乐。
words.en: If two or more people or things have something in common, they share the same interests or experiences, or have similar characteristics.

words.tr: phrase. 至于；就…来说；在...的情况
words.ex: In the case of rain, we will stay inside.
words.ex_cn: 如果下雨，我们就待在室内。
words.en: used to describe a particular situation or instance

words.tr: phrase. 装载；装满；把（货物、弹药、程序等）装入；使大量摄入（食物、饮料、药物等）
words.ex: He likes to load up on snacks before the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在看电影前买很多零食。
words.en: To fill or pack something with a large amount of something.

words.tr: phrase. 露面；出席；出现；公开亮相
words.ex: He will make an appearance at the party tonight.
words.ex_cn: 他今晚会出现在聚会上。
words.en: To come into sight or to be present at an event or function.

words.ex: They will pay tribute to the hero at the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他们将在仪式上向这位英雄致敬。
words.en: To express admiration, respect, or gratitude towards someone or something, often publicly.

chapters.name: Unit 3 Text A New Words

words.ex: France was an ally of the United States in the war.
words.ex_cn: 法国在战争中是美国的同盟者。
words.en: An ally is a country, organization, or person that helps and supports another country, organization, or person in a difficult situation.

words.tr: adj. 安纳托利亚的；安纳托利亚人的
words.ex: The ancient city is located in Anatolian region.
words.ex_cn: 这座古城位于安纳托利亚地区。
words.en: Relating to Anatolia or its people, culture, or languages.

words.tr: adj. 角的；有角的；尖角的；
words.ex: The angular shape of the triangle is clear.
words.ex_cn: 三角形的角形很清晰。
words.en: having angles or sharp corners; lean and bony

words.ex: He is arguably the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 可以说他是队里最好的球员。
words.en: Used when stating an opinion that you believe could be proved true.

words.tr: n. 人工制品；手工艺品；加工品
words.ex: The museum has an ancient artifact.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一件古代文物。
words.en: An artifact is an object that is made by a person, especially something of historical or cultural interest.

words.tr:
n. 包；捆
v. 捆成大包
words.ex: He tied the hay into a bale.
words.ex_cn: 他把干草捆成一捆。
words.en: A bale is a large quantity of something such as hay, paper, wool, or cloth that has been tied tightly into a rectangular shape.

words.ex: The bridge has a cantilever design.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥采用悬臂设计。
words.en: A cantilever is a long projecting beam or girder fixed at only one end, used chiefly in bridge construction.

words.tr: adj. 著名的； v. 庆祝；“celebrate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a celebrated painter in China.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位在中国著名的画家。
words.en: A celebrated person or thing is famous and much admired.

words.tr: v. 描述…的特性；以…为特征；
words.ex: This book characterizes the hero as brave and kind.
words.ex_cn: 这本书将主人公描述为勇敢而善良的。
words.en: To describe the character or qualities of someone or something.

words.ex: The team showed cohesive behavior during the project.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队在项目期间表现出有凝聚力的行为。
words.en: If something is cohesive, it consists of parts that fit together well and form a united whole.

words.tr:
v. 补充；与…相辅相成；
n. 补足物；补语；余角；
words.ex: The red scarf complements her blue coat.
words.ex_cn: 这条红围巾补充了她的蓝外套。
words.en: To complement something means to make it complete or perfect by adding something to it.

words.ex: His words were contradictory.
words.ex_cn: 他的话是矛盾的。
words.en: If two or more facts, ideas, or statements are contradictory, they state or imply that opposite things are true.

words.ex: Some people follow that cult blindly.
words.ex_cn: 有些人盲目追随那个狂热崇拜。
words.en: A cult is a group of people who have extreme admiration for a particular person, idea, or thing, often following unusual or extreme practices or beliefs.

words.tr: v. 区分；“distinguish”的现在分词； adj. 区别性的；
words.ex: He is distinguishing between the two similar colors.
words.ex_cn: 他正在区分这两种相似的颜色。
words.en: Serving to identify someone or something as different from others.

words.ex: The dominant color in the room is blue.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间占优势的颜色是蓝色。
words.en: Someone or something that is dominant is more powerful, successful, influential, or noticeable than other people or things.

words.ex: He works hard to emulate his older brother.
words.ex_cn: 他努力赶上他的哥哥。
words.en: To emulate someone or something means to try to be like them or to do something in the same way that they do it.

words.tr:
n. 等价物；
adj. 相等的；等价的；
words.ex: The dollar is the equivalent of ten yuan.
words.ex_cn: 美元是十元的等价物。
words.en: If one amount or value is the equivalent of another, they are the same.

words.tr: n. 伊特鲁里亚人；伊特鲁里亚语 adj. 伊特鲁里亚的
words.ex: The Etruscan pottery is very old.
words.ex_cn: 伊特鲁里亚陶器非常古老。
words.en: Relating to ancient Etruria, its people, or their language.

words.ex: She has a feminine voice.
words.ex_cn: 她的声音很女性化。
words.en: having qualities or an appearance traditionally associated with women, especially delicacy and prettiness.

words.ex: We took the ferry to cross the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘渡船过河。
words.en: A ferry is a boat that transports passengers and sometimes also vehicles, usually across rivers or short stretches of sea.

words.ex: The trees showed bright foliage in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 秋天时，树木呈现出鲜艳的叶子。
words.en: The leaves of a plant or tree, or the leaves on trees and plants collectively.

words.tr:
n. 家具；设备；配备
v. 布置家具；配备；“furnish”的现在分词
words.ex: The furnishing of the apartment includes a sofa, table, and chairs.
words.ex_cn: 这个公寓的家具包括一张沙发、一张桌子和几把椅子。
words.en: Furnishing refers to the furniture, fixtures, and other movable objects in a building or room that make it suitable for living or working.

words.ex: He drew a geometric shape on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个几何图形。
words.en: Relating to geometry, or according to its methods and principles.

words.tr: adj. 控制的；管理的； v. “govern”的现在分词；
words.ex: The governing rules are simple and clear.
words.ex_cn: 控制的规则简单而清晰。
words.en: Having the authority to control or direct the actions of a country, organization, or group.

words.tr: n. 居住；生活环境；住所
words.ex: The old house has no habitation now.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子现在没有人居住。
words.en: The act of living in a place; a place where someone lives.

words.tr: n. 意识形态；思想体系；
words.ex: His ideology is based on equality and justice.
words.ex_cn: 他的意识形态基于平等与正义。
words.en: An ideology is a set of beliefs, especially one held by a particular group, that influences the way people think and behave.

words.ex: His idiosyncratic style makes his art easy to recognize.
words.ex_cn: 他独特的风格使他的艺术容易被认出。
words.en: If you describe someone's actions or characteristics as idiosyncratic, you mean that they are rather unusual.

words.tr: v. 强迫；推行； adj. 自己担负的 v. 强迫( impose的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The government imposed a new tax on sugar.
words.ex_cn: 政府强迫征收了一项新的糖税。
words.en: If you impose something on people, you use your authority to force them to accept it.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.ex: The boxer is a lightweight fighter.
words.ex_cn: 这位拳击手是一名轻量级选手。
words.en: Something that is lightweight weighs less than average or is less heavy than usual. It can also refer to someone who is not very important or influential.

words.ex: His sadness manifested in his quiet eyes.
words.ex_cn: 他的悲伤表现在他安静的眼神中。
words.en: To manifest something means to show it clearly and visibly.

words.ex: He has a masculine voice and strong build.
words.ex_cn: 他声音低沉，身材强壮。
words.en: Having qualities or appearance traditionally associated with men.

words.ex: He thinks in a mechanistic way, like a machine.
words.ex_cn: 他以机械的方式思考，就像一台机器。
words.en: If you describe a view or explanation of something as mechanistic, you are criticizing it because it describes a natural or social process as if it were a machine.

words.tr:
adj. 多汞的；含汞的；易变的；灵活的；反复无常的
n. 汞制剂；水银剂
words.ex: His mercurial mood changes from happy to angry quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他多汞的情绪很快从高兴变到生气。
words.en: If you describe someone as mercurial, you mean that they frequently change their mind or mood without warning.

words.tr: adj. 米诺斯文明的；米诺斯文化的 n. 米诺斯人；米诺斯语
words.ex: The Minoan civilization built palaces on Crete.
words.ex_cn: 米诺斯文明在克里特岛建造了宫殿。
words.en: Relating to the Bronze Age civilization of Crete, known for its art and architecture, which flourished from about 3000 to 1100 BC.

words.ex: He is a multifaceted person who can sing, paint, and code.
words.ex_cn: 他是个多方面的人，会唱歌、绘画和编程。
words.en: Having many facets or aspects.

words.ex: The system shows non-linearity when small changes cause big effects.
words.ex_cn: 当微小的变化导致巨大影响时，系统表现出非线性。
words.en: Non-linearity refers to the property of a system or process that does not follow a straight-line relationship between cause and effect.

words.ex: She buys organic vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买有机蔬菜。
words.en: Relating to or derived from living matter; denoting or characterized by a harmonious relationship between the elements of a whole.

words.tr: n. 生物体；有机体；有机组织；
words.ex: A bacterium is a simple organism.
words.ex_cn: 细菌是一种简单的生物体。
words.en: An organism is a living thing that has an organized structure, can react to stimuli, reproduce, grow, adapt, and maintain homeostasis.

words.tr: adj. 执拗的；任性的；乖张的；故意作对的；悖理的
words.ex: He gave a perverse answer to the simple question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个简单的问题给出了一个反常的答案。
words.en: If you describe someone as perverse, you mean that they deliberately behave in an unreasonable way, especially by doing the opposite of what is expected or wanted.

words.ex: The old temple has four stone pillars.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙有四根石柱。
words.en: A pillar is a tall solid structure, which is usually used to support part of a building.

words.ex: She wrote a poetic letter to her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她给朋友写了一封诗意的信。
words.en: Something that is poetic is very beautiful and expresses emotions in a sensitive or moving way.

words.tr: adj. 普遍的；流行的；盛行的；
words.ex: Smoking is prevalent in that country.
words.ex_cn: 在那个国家，吸烟很普遍。
words.en: If a condition, practice, or belief is prevalent, it is common or widespread.

words.ex: The logo is recognizable even from far away.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志即使从远处也能辨认出来。
words.en: Able to be recognized or identified from previous encounters or knowledge.

words.ex: The box has a rectangle shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是长方形的。
words.en: A rectangle is a four-sided flat shape where every interior angle is a right angle (90°). Opposite sides are parallel and of equal length.

words.tr: adj. 直线运动的；形成直线的；用直线围着的
words.ex: The building has a rectilinear design with sharp, straight lines.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑具有直线设计，线条锐利、笔直。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by straight lines.

words.tr: adv. 僵硬地；严格地；固执地
words.ex: He follows the rules rigidly.
words.ex_cn: 他严格遵守规则。
words.en: In a strict or inflexible manner.

words.tr: v. 俯冲；猛冲；俯冲，猛冲( swoop的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The hawk was swooping down to catch a mouse.
words.ex_cn: 老鹰正在俯冲下来抓一只老鼠。
words.en: Moving rapidly downward through the air, especially in order to attack or catch something.

words.tr: adj. 共栖的；共生的；互惠互利的；
words.ex: The clownfish and the sea anemone have a symbiotic relationship.
words.ex_cn: 小丑鱼和海葵有共栖关系。
words.en: Involving interaction between two different organisms living in close physical association, typically to the advantage of both.

words.ex: She was sympathetic to his problems.
words.ex_cn: 她对他的问题很同情。
words.en: If you are sympathetic to someone who is in a bad situation, you are kind to them and show that you understand their feelings.

words.ex: The rope has high tensile strength.
words.ex_cn: 这根绳子有很高的抗拉强度。
words.en: relating to tension; capable of being stretched or drawn out

words.ex: The children set up a teepee in the backyard for their camping adventure.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在后院搭起了一个圆锥形帐篷，准备他们的露营冒险。
words.en: A teepee is a tent in the shape of a cone, traditionally used by Native Americans.

words.tr: n. 一捆；一束（干草、稻草）；
words.ex: He carried a truss of hay to the barn.
words.ex_cn: 他扛了一捆干草到谷仓。
words.en: To tie up or bind tightly; to support or strengthen with a framework.

words.tr: v. （使）统一；“unify”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 统一的；
words.ex: The two schools unified their programs last year.
words.ex_cn: 这两所学校去年统一了它们的课程。
words.en: Made into or caused to form a single unit or entity.

words.ex: The bank keeps money in a vault.
words.ex_cn: 银行把钱存放在金库里。
words.en: A vault is an arched structure that forms a ceiling or roof, or a room, especially in a church, that has an arched ceiling or roof. It can also refer to a jump over something using your hands or a pole to push yourself off the ground.

words.tr:
adj. 本国的；地方的
n. 方言；土语
words.ex: He wrote the poem in the vernacular language.
words.ex_cn: 他用本国语言写了这首诗。
words.en: The vernacular is the language or dialect spoken by the ordinary people in a particular country or region.

words.ex: The wavy line looks like a snake.
words.ex_cn: 波浪形的线看起来像一条蛇。
words.en: Something that is wavy has a series of curves or waves in it.

chapters.name: Unit 3 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 被与……整合；被与……结合（指事物相互融合或协调地组合在一起）
words.ex: The new app is integrated with the school system.
words.ex_cn: 这个新应用与学校系统整合在一起。
words.en: To be combined or joined with something else to form a single, unified system or entity.

words.tr: phrase. 源于；根植于；起源于（某事物）
words.ex: His beliefs are rooted in tradition.
words.ex_cn: 他的信念源于传统。
words.en: To have a firm foundation or origin in something.

words.tr: phrase. 对...表示同情的；体谅的；支持的
words.ex_cn: 他对穷人有同情心。
words.en: To show understanding and support for someone's feelings or situation.

words.ex: This task is beyond the capabilities of an average person.
words.ex_cn: 这项任务超出了普通人的能力。
words.en: Outside the limits of someone's or something's ability.

words.ex: The village is far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄远离城市。
words.en: If you say that something is far from a particular thing or far from being the case, you are emphasizing that it is not that particular thing or not at all the case, especially when people expect or assume that it is.

words.ex: We need to free up space for the new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要为新家具腾出空间。
words.en: To make something available by removing it from use or occupancy.

words.tr: phrase. 与...协调一致；与...和谐
words.ex: The painting is in harmony with the room's colors.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画与房间的颜色相协调。
words.en: If one thing is in harmony with another, the first thing suits the second or they seem right together.

words.ex: He voted in opposition to the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 他投票反对新政策。
words.en: If you are in opposition to someone or something, you disagree with them or are against them.

words.tr: phrase. 四面围坐地（指观众围绕舞台或雕塑四周观看）；立体地；全面地；完整呈现地
words.ex: We need to view this issue in the round to understand all aspects of it.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要从各个角度来看待这个问题，以理解其所有方面。
words.en: If something is done or viewed in the round, it is done or viewed with all aspects or features considered, not just one or a few.

words.tr: phrase. 畅所欲言；打开；开放
words.ex: Please open up and tell me how you really feel.
words.ex_cn: 请畅所欲言，告诉我你真正的感受。
words.en: To make something available or accessible; to start or begin something.

words.tr: phrase. 把…固定住；找某人问清；确定
words.ex: He used a nail to pin down the map on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他用钉子把地图固定在墙上。
words.en: To pin something down means to identify or define it clearly and precisely.

words.tr: phrase. 追溯到；延伸至（某时间或地点）
words.ex: The history of this town stretch back to the 12th century.
words.ex_cn: 这个城镇的历史可以追溯到12世纪。
words.en: If something stretches back to a particular time, it started or existed at that time and has continued to exist or happen since then.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细考虑；想出（解决方案或计划）
words.ex: He thinks out the answer carefully before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他在说话前仔细思考答案。
words.en: To think something out means to consider it carefully and thoroughly before making a decision or taking action.

chapters.name: Unit 3 Text B New Words

words.ex: His calmness is the antithesis of her anger.
words.ex_cn: 他的冷静是她愤怒的反面。
words.en: The antithesis of something is its exact opposite.

words.ex: His aspiration is to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他的渴望是成为一名医生。
words.en: A strong desire to achieve something high or great.

words.ex: He will assemble the toy for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他将为儿子组装玩具。
words.en: If people assemble or if someone assembles them, they come together in a group, usually for a particular purpose such as a meeting.

words.tr: n. 顾问工作；顾问职位；咨询公司；
words.ex: He works in consultancy for big companies.
words.ex_cn: 他为大公司做顾问工作。
words.en: Consultancy is the business or activity of giving expert advice to people working in a particular field.

words.tr: v. 精确地解释；使明确；规定( define的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The teacher is defining the word clearly.
words.ex_cn: 老师正在精确地解释这个词。
words.en: If you define something, you show, describe, or state clearly what it is and what its limits are, or what it is like.

words.ex: They will demolish the old building next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周会拆掉那座旧建筑。
words.en: To demolish something such as a building means to destroy it completely. It can also mean to defeat someone completely in a discussion, argument, or competition.

words.tr: adj. 逐渐减少的； v. 减少；减损；“diminish”的现在分词；
words.ex: The diminishing supply of water causes problems.
words.ex_cn: 逐渐减少的水资源供应引发了问题。
words.en: Becoming smaller or less; decreasing.

words.ex: His discourse on climate change was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他关于气候变化的论述清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: Discourse is spoken or written communication between people, especially serious discussion of a particular subject.

words.tr: v. 装入胶囊；压缩；简述；概括
words.ex: The pharmacist encapsulate the medicine into small capsules.
words.ex_cn: 药剂师把药物装入小胶囊中。
words.en: To encapsulate something means to express or show the most important facts about it in a very short and clear form.

words.ex: The film is an homage to old Hollywood movies.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是对老好莱坞电影的致敬。
words.en: Homage is respect shown towards someone or something you admire, or to a person in authority.

words.tr: v. 逐步渗透；逐渐灌输
words.ex: Parents try to instill good habits in their children.
words.ex_cn: 父母试图在孩子身上培养良好的习惯。
words.en: To instill something in someone means to gradually but firmly establish an idea or attitude in their mind.

words.ex: The wires are intricately connected.
words.ex_cn: 这些电线复杂地连接在一起。
words.en: In a manner that is very complicated or detailed.

words.ex: He wrote a manifesto to explain his ideas.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份宣言来解释他的观点。
words.en: A manifesto is a written statement of the beliefs, aims, and policies of an organization, especially a political party.

words.ex: The occupant of the room is sleeping.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的住户正在睡觉。
words.en: An occupant is someone who lives in or uses a particular room, building, or area of land.

words.ex: The museum focuses on the preservation of old books.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆专注于旧书的保存。
words.en: The act of keeping something in its original state or in good condition.

words.tr: v. 使夷为平地；彻底摧毁
words.ex: They will raze the old building next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周将把那座旧建筑夷为平地。
words.en: To raze a building, town, or forest means to completely destroy it, especially by knocking it down or burning it.

words.ex: The new coach reinvigorated the team.
words.ex_cn: 新教练使球队重振活力。
words.en: To give new energy or strength to someone or something.

words.ex: The relevance of this topic is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这个主题的相关性是明显的。
words.en: The quality or state of being closely connected or appropriate.

words.ex: The renovation of the old house took three months.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子的革新花了三个月。
words.en: The act of improving by renewing and restoring.

words.ex: The child ripped the paper with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用手把纸撕裂了。
words.en: To rip something means to tear it quickly and forcefully.

words.tr: n. 根深蒂固，牢不可破
words.ex: Her rootedness in the community made her a respected leader.
words.ex_cn: 她在这个社区的根深蒂固使她成为一位受人尊敬的领导者。
words.en: The state or quality of being firmly established or deeply embedded in a particular place, culture, or environment.

words.tr: adj. 不受妨碍的；没有负担的
words.ex: She felt unencumbered by the responsibilities of her former job.
words.ex_cn: 她感觉摆脱了以前工作中的责任负担。
words.en: If you are unencumbered by something, you are not burdened or hindered by it, allowing you to move or act freely.

chapters.name: Unit 3 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: How did this mistake come about?
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是怎么发生的？
words.en: If you ask how something came about, you want to know how it happened or started.

words.tr: phrase. 与某人互动；与某人建立联系；与某人交往
words.ex: It's important to engage with your audience during a presentation.
words.ex_cn: 在演讲过程中与观众互动是很重要的。
words.en: To interact or communicate with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 参与某事；与某事物互动或建立联系
words.ex: The company needs to engage more with its customers to understand their needs.
words.ex_cn: 公司需要更多地与客户接触，以了解他们的需求。
words.en: To engage with something means to become involved in it or to interact with it in a meaningful way.

words.tr: phrase. 不在某人的关注范围内；被某人忽视或遗忘；不再被注意到
words.ex: The project is off my radar for now.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目目前不在我的关注范围内。
words.en: If something is off your radar, you are not aware of it or are not thinking about it.

words.tr: phrase. 向…致敬；向…表示敬意；对…表达崇敬
words.ex: The artist painted a picture to pay homage to his mother.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家画了一幅画来向他的母亲致敬。
words.en: To pay homage to someone or something means to show your respect for them, especially by praising them in public.

words.tr: phrase. 努力做某事；力争做某事
words.ex: We must strive to do our best in everything we undertake.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须在我们承担的每一件事上力求做到最好。
words.en: To make a great effort to achieve something.

chapters.name: Unit 4 Text A New Words

words.ex: This food contains a harmless additive for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物含有用于调味的无害添加物。
words.en: An additive is a substance which is added in small amounts to something else in order to improve it, preserve it, or make it more effective.

words.tr: n. 装订工；粘合剂；活页夹
words.ex: The binder stitched the pages together neatly.
words.ex_cn: 装订工把页面整齐地装订在一起。
words.en: A binder is a cover for holding loose sheets of paper, magazines, etc., together.

words.ex: He bought a brand-new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一辆全新的自行车。
words.en: Completely new, as if recently made or acquired.

words.tr: adj. 令人信服的； v. “compel”的现在分词；
words.ex: His story was compelling and made everyone listen.
words.ex_cn: 他的故事令人信服，让所有人都认真聆听。
words.en: A compelling argument or reason is one that makes you believe it or accept it because it is so strong.

words.ex: The number of apples corresponds to the number of oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的数量与橙子的数量相对应。
words.en: If one thing corresponds to another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one is the cause or the result of the other.

words.tr: n. 用户化，专用化，定制
words.ex: The software allows for extensive customization to meet individual needs.
words.ex_cn: 该软件允许进行广泛的定制以满足个人需求。
words.en: The action of modifying something to suit a particular individual or task.

words.ex: This phone has cutting-edge technology.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机拥有尖端技术。
words.en: Something that is cutting-edge is at the forefront of technological or other developments.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.ex: He decided to discard his old habits.
words.ex_cn: 他决定抛开旧习惯。
words.en: To discard something means to get rid of it because you no longer want it or need it.

words.tr: n. 被除数；股份红利；股息
words.ex: In 12 ÷ 3 = 4, the dividend is 12.
words.en: A dividend is a sum of money paid regularly (typically annually) by a company to its shareholders out of its profits (or reserves).

words.tr: n. 进入者；新到者；新成员
words.ex: The entrant must pass the test to join.
words.ex_cn: 参赛者必须通过考试才能加入。
words.en: An entrant is someone who joins a particular group, organization, or activity, especially in order to take part in a competition or an examination.

words.ex: His story was an exaggeration of the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他的故事是对事实的夸张。
words.en: An exaggeration is a statement that represents something as better or worse than it really is.

words.ex: The fabrication of the machine took three weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的制备花了三周时间。
words.en: The act of inventing or producing something false in order to deceive someone.

words.ex: The elephant is gigantic compared to a dog.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象相比狗来说是巨大的。
words.en: If you describe something as gigantic, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr: n. 重型卡车；不可抗拒的强大力量；无法控制的强大机构；使人盲目牺牲（或崇拜）的事物
words.ex: The juggernaut rolled down the highway, carrying heavy cargo.
words.ex_cn: 这辆重型卡车沿着高速公路行驶，载着沉重的货物。
words.en: A juggernaut is something or someone that is extremely large, powerful, and unstoppable.

words.ex: This farm is labor-intensive because it needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场是劳动密集型的，因为它需要很多工人。
words.en: Requiring a large amount of labor relative to capital.

words.ex: He is largely responsible for the project's success.
words.ex_cn: 他主要对这个项目的成功负责。
words.en: To a great extent; mostly.

words.ex: The cake has three layers of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有三层巧克力。
words.en: A layer of a substance or material is a quantity or piece of it that covers a surface or that is between two other things.

words.tr: n. 差额；边缘；净利润；余地；
words.ex: The profit margin is five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 利润差额是五美元。
words.en: The margin is the edge or border of something, or the difference between two amounts, especially the difference between the cost of producing something and the price it is sold for.

words.ex: The bacteria are microscopic.
words.ex_cn: 这些细菌极小。
words.en: So small as to be visible only with a microscope; of or relating to a microscope.

words.ex: He answered the question niftily.
words.ex_cn: 他俏皮地回答了问题。
words.en: In a neat, clever, or effective manner.

words.tr: adj. 整直的；矫正的; n. 矫正具
words.ex: He uses an orthotic device to correct his posture.
words.ex_cn: 他使用矫正器来矫正姿势。
words.en: An orthotic is a device designed to support or correct the function of a limb or the spine.

words.ex: He made a painstaking effort to fix the small details.
words.ex_cn: 他细心地努力修正每一个小细节。
words.en: If you describe someone's work as painstaking, you mean that they do it very carefully and thoroughly, often taking a long time.

words.tr:
adj. 粉状的；涂粉的
v. 搽粉于； 撒粉；使成粉末；“powder”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He added powdered sugar to the coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他往咖啡里加了糖粉。
words.en: Made into or resembling powder.

words.ex: The old woman predict rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 那位老妇人预言明天会下雨。
words.en: If you predict an event, you say that it will happen.

words.ex: The factory improved its productivity by using new machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂通过使用新机器提高了生产率。
words.en: Productivity is the rate at which goods are produced or work is completed.

words.tr: v. 将机械重新整备；重组
words.ex: The factory had to retool to meet new production standards.
words.ex_cn: 工厂必须更换工具以满足新的生产标准。
words.en: To retool means to alter or adapt something, especially machinery or a system, so that it can be used for a different purpose or in a different way.

words.ex: He uses a scanner to copy documents.
words.ex_cn: 他使用扫描仪来复制文件。
words.en: A scanner is a device that captures images from photographic prints, posters, magazine pages, and similar sources for computer editing and display.

words.ex: He failed the test, but subsequent efforts helped him pass.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，但随后的努力让他通过了。
words.en: Following in time or order; succeeding.

words.ex: The painter applied paint on a wooden substrate.
words.ex_cn: 画家在木制底层上涂了颜料。
words.en: A substrate is a substance or layer that underlies something, or on which some process occurs, in particular.

words.ex: The subtractive method removes color from light.
words.ex_cn: 减法方法从光中移除颜色。
words.en: Relating to or involving subtraction.

words.tr: n. 晶体管；晶体管收音机
words.ex: The radio uses a small transistor.
words.ex_cn: 这个收音机使用了一个小晶体管。
words.en: A transistor is a semiconductor device used to amplify or switch electronic signals and electrical power.

words.tr: vt. 排字，把书稿输入计算机
words.ex: They typeset the entire book in just one week.
words.ex_cn: 他们仅用一周时间就完成了整本书的排字工作。
words.en: To arrange and prepare text and images for printing, especially in a book, magazine, or newspaper.

words.ex: The detective uncovered the truth.
words.ex_cn: 侦探揭开了真相。
words.en: To uncover something means to remove the cover from it or to reveal it by investigation or inquiry.

words.ex: He had to undergo surgery last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周不得不接受手术。
words.en: If you undergo something necessary or unpleasant, it happens to you or is done to you.

words.tr: n. 分水岭；集水区；转折点
words.ex: The river forms a watershed between two valleys.
words.ex_cn: 这条河构成了两个山谷之间的分水岭。
words.en: A watershed is an event or period that is important because it represents a big change in how people do or think about something.

chapters.name: Unit 4 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 一艘正在下沉的船；常用于比喻即将失败或崩溃的组织、计划或事业
words.ex: He left the sinking ship quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速离开了正在下沉的船。
words.en: A metaphor for a failing organization, project, or situation that is doomed to collapse.

words.tr: phrase. 准备好做某事； poised 表示处于即将行动的状态， ready and waiting to take action
words.ex: The company is poised to launch its new product next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司准备在下个月推出新产品。
words.en: To be ready to do something or to be about to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 两全其美；同时享受两种好处或优势
words.ex: Working from home offers the best of both worlds: the comfort of your home and the productivity of an office.
words.ex_cn: 在家工作提供了两全其美的解决方案：家庭的舒适和办公室的效率。
words.en: A situation in which you can enjoy the advantages of two very different things at the same time.

words.ex: He wants to cut down on sugar to be healthier.
words.ex_cn: 他想减少糖的摄入来更健康。
words.en: To reduce the amount or number of something.

words.tr: phrase. 完全一样好；丝毫不差地好
words.ex: Her performance was every bit as good as the professionals.
words.ex_cn: 她的表演和专业人士一样好。
words.en: Just as good as something or someone else, with no difference in quality or performance.

words.tr: phrase. 完全一样糟糕；丝毫不比……好
words.ex: The new system is every bit as bad as the old one.
words.ex_cn: 新系统与旧系统一样糟糕。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is just as bad as something else.

words.w: every bit as good as sb.
words.tr: 短语. 和某人一样优秀；丝毫不逊色于某人
words.uk: ˈevri bɪt æz ɡʊd æz ˈsʌmbədi
words.us: ˈevri bɪt æz ɡʊd æz ˈsʌmbədi
words.ex: She's every bit as good as her sister at playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 她在弹钢琴方面和她姐姐一样好。
words.en: Just as good as someone or something else.

words.w: every bit as bad as sb.
words.tr: phrase. phrase. 完全一样坏；丝毫不比某人好
words.uk: ˈevri bɪt əz bæd əz səmˈbədi
words.us: ˈɛvri bɪt əz bæd əz ˈsʌmbədi
words.ex: She is every bit as bad as he is.
words.ex_cn: 她和他是半斤八两。
words.en: Just as bad as someone else, without any difference.

words.w: every bit as good as sth.
words.tr: 短语，和某物一样好，丝毫不差
words.uk: ˈevri bɪt æz ɡʊd æz ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: ˈevri bɪt æz ɡʊd æz ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: This new product is every bit as good as the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这个新产品和旧的一样好。
words.en: If you say that something is every bit as good as something else, you mean that it is just as good as the other thing.

words.w: every bit as bad as sth.
words.tr: phrase. phrase. 完全一样糟糕，丝毫不比某事好
words.uk: ˈevri bɪt əz bæd əz ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: ˈevri bɪt əz bæd əz ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: The weather this summer is every bit as bad as last year.
words.ex_cn: 今年夏天的天气和去年一样糟糕。
words.en: Just as bad as something else; equally bad.

words.w: get in on the ground floor
words.tr: 短语动词. 在初期就参与进来，通常指在项目、企业或机会刚开始时就加入，以获得最大利益
words.uk: ɡet ɪn ɒn ðə ɡraʊnd flɔː(r)
words.us: ɡet ɪn ɑːn ðə ɡraʊnd flɔːr
words.ex: He got in on the ground floor of the new tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他早早加入了这家新科技公司。
words.en: To become involved in something at the beginning, especially when it is likely to be successful.

words.tr: phrase. 发大财；赚大钱；积累巨额财富
words.ex: He made a fortune by selling his small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卖掉自己的小生意发了一笔财。
words.en: To earn a large amount of money, often in a short period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 发财；致富；发迹；取得成功
words.ex: He went to the city to make his fortune.
words.ex_cn: 他去城里发财了。
words.en: To become very rich or successful, especially by one's own efforts.

words.tr: phrase. 产生红利；带来好处；取得回报
words.ex: Hard work will pay dividends in the future.
words.ex_cn: 努力工作将来会得到回报。
words.en: To produce benefits or advantages as a result of something done earlier.

words.tr: phrase. 后部；车尾；（口语）臀部
words.ex: The car's rear end was severely damaged in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的后部在事故中严重受损。
words.en: The back part of something, especially a vehicle or a person's body.

words.ex: The children loved to slide along the icy sidewalk.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢沿着结冰的人行道滑行。
words.en: To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it.

words.tr: phrase. 转折点；关键时刻；改变局势的事件
words.ex: The accident was a turning point in his life.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是他人生的一个转折点。
words.en: A turning point is a time at which an important change takes place which affects the future of a person or thing.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐减少；削减（数量、规模等）
words.ex: The company had to whittle down its workforce due to budget cuts.
words.ex_cn: 由于预算削减，公司不得不削减员工人数。
words.en: To reduce the amount or size of something gradually.

chapters.name: Unit 4 Text B New Words

words.ex: He touched his abdomen after eating too much.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完太多后摸了摸肚子。
words.en: The abdomen is the part of the body between the chest and the pelvis, containing the stomach, intestines, liver, and other organs.

words.tr:
n. 麻醉剂；麻醉药
adj. 麻醉的
words.ex: The doctor gave him an anesthetic before the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 医生在手术前给他用了麻醉剂。
words.en: An anesthetic is a substance that causes loss of sensation or consciousness, used especially to prevent pain during medical procedures.

words.tr: v. 批准；认可；通过；赞成(连of)
words.ex: My mom will approve my new phone.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈会同意我买新手机。
words.en: If you approve of an action, event, or suggestion, you like it or are pleased about it.

words.ex: He is an avid reader of mystery novels.
words.ex_cn: 他热衷于阅读侦探小说。
words.en: If you say that someone is avid for something, you mean that they are very eager to get it.

words.ex: The bag is biodegradable.
words.ex_cn: 这个袋子是可生物降解的。
words.en: A substance or chemical that is biodegradable can be decomposed by bacteria or other living organisms, and therefore does not pollute the environment.

words.tr: n. 一阵强劲的气流；爆炸；
words.ex: A blast of cold wind hit the window.
words.ex_cn: 一阵冷风击中了窗户。
words.en: A blast is a sudden loud noise or a strong gust of wind. It can also refer to an explosion or the act of blowing something up. As a verb, it means to explode or to criticize severely.

words.tr: n. 荞麦粉; 蓼科荞麦属; 荞麦种; 荍
words.ex: Buckwheat is often used in making pancakes.
words.ex_cn: 荞麦常用于制作薄饼。
words.en: Buckwheat is a plant cultivated for its grain-like seeds, and as a cover crop. Despite the name, buckwheat is not related to wheat, as it is not a grass; instead, buckwheat is related to sorrel, knotweed, and rhubarb.

words.ex: He took a capsule for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒胶囊来缓解头痛。
words.en: A capsule is a small container or case, especially one that is sealed and contains a dose of medicine, or a spacecraft's compartment for astronauts.

words.ex: The dentist found a cavity in his tooth.
words.ex_cn: 牙医在他的牙齿上发现了一个腔。
words.en: A cavity is a hole or space inside something.

words.tr:
n. 陶瓷制品；陶瓷器；
adj. 陶质的；制陶的；
words.ex: He bought a ceramic bowl at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个陶瓷碗。
words.en: Ceramic is a hard material that is made by baking clay or similar substances at high temperatures. It is used to make things such as tiles, dishes, and statues.

words.tr: n. 涂层； v. “coat”的现在分词；
words.ex: The metal has a protective coating.
words.ex_cn: 这种金属有一层保护涂层。
words.en: A coating is a layer of a substance spread over a surface for protection or decoration.

words.ex: The table is made of a composite material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由一种合成材料制成的。
words.en: A composite is something that is made up of several different parts or materials.

words.ex: She put the apples in a plastic container.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个塑料容器里。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.tr:
n. 腐烂；衰落；
v. 腐烂；
words.ex: The fruit began to show signs of decay.
words.ex_cn: 这水果开始出现腐烂的迹象。
words.en: To decay means to be slowly destroyed by a natural process or to become gradually worse in quality, condition, or strength.

words.ex: He went to the dental clinic for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去牙科诊所做检查。
words.en: Relating to the teeth or to the work of a dentist.

words.tr: adj. 渴望的；想得到的； v. 渴望；“desire”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He got the desired job after months of searching.
words.ex_cn: 经过几个月的寻找，他得到了渴望的工作。
words.en: Wished for or wanted.

words.ex: This car is economical because it uses little fuel.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车很经济，因为它耗油少。
words.en: Using money, resources, or time in a careful and effective way.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的；合意的；
words.ex: He is eligible to vote because he is 18 years old.
words.ex_cn: 他年满18岁，有资格投票。
words.en: Someone who is eligible for something is qualified or allowed to do it.

words.ex: The enforcement of traffic laws keeps roads safe.
words.ex_cn: 交通法规的执行使道路更安全。
words.en: The act of compelling observance of or compliance with a law, rule, or obligation.

words.tr: n. 织物；（建筑物的）结构；
words.ex: The dress is made of soft fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子是由柔软的织物制成的。
words.en: Fabric refers to cloth or other material produced by weaving together cotton, nylon, wool, silk, or other threads. It can also refer to the basic structure of a building or a system.

words.ex: The fungus grows on old trees.
words.ex_cn: 真菌生长在老树上。
words.en: A fungus is a simple type of plant that has no leaves or flowers and that grows on plants or decaying matter.

words.ex: The mixture turned into a gelatinous substance after cooling.
words.ex_cn: 混合物冷却后变成了胶状物质。
words.en: Having a jelly-like consistency.

words.ex: He wears a helmet when he rides a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车时戴头盔。
words.en: A helmet is a strong, hard hat which is worn to protect your head.

words.tr: n. 徒步旅行者；远足者
words.ex: The hiker walked up the mountain slowly.
words.ex_cn: 这位徒步者慢慢爬上了山。
words.en: A hiker is a person who walks long distances, especially across country.

words.ex: The corn has a dry husk around it.
words.ex_cn: 玉米外面有一层干外壳。
words.en: The outer covering of some fruits and seeds, especially when it is dry and hard.
