words.ex: The dentist placed a dental implant to replace the missing tooth.
words.ex_cn: 牙医植入了一个牙科植入物来替代缺失的牙齿。
words.en: To implant something means to put it firmly into something else, especially into a person's body.

words.ex: The wound caused a serious infection.
words.ex_cn: 伤口引起了严重的感染。
words.en: An infection is a disease caused by microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, or parasites invading the body.

words.tr: n. [医] 接种；接木；接插芽
words.ex: The child received inoculation against measles last week.
words.ex_cn: 孩子上周接种了麻疹疫苗。
words.en: The act of introducing a vaccine into the body to produce immunity to a specific disease.

words.ex: The house has good insulation to keep warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有良好的绝缘层以在冬天保暖。
words.en: Insulation is a material or substance that is used to stop heat, electricity, or sound from going from one place to another.

words.ex: The window was covered with a lattice of iron bars.
words.ex_cn: 窗户被铁条格子覆盖。
words.en: A lattice is a structure consisting of strips of wood or metal crossed and fastened together with square or diamond-shaped spaces left between.

words.ex: The baker used a metal mold to shape the cake.
words.ex_cn: 面包师用一个金属模具来塑造蛋糕。
words.en: A mold is a hollow container used to give shape to molten or hot liquid material when it cools and hardens. It can also refer to a fungus that grows on food or damp surfaces.

words.ex: The mycelium spreads through the soil, absorbing nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 菌丝体在土壤中蔓延，吸收营养。
words.en: The vegetative part of a fungus, consisting of a network of fine white filaments (hyphae).

words.ex: Nanoparticles are used in various medical applications.
words.ex_cn: 纳米粒子被用于各种医疗应用中。
words.en: A nanoparticle is a microscopic particle with at least one dimension less than 100 nm. It is used in various fields including medicine, electronics, and materials science.

words.ex: He quit smoking to avoid nicotine.
words.ex_cn: 他戒烟以避免尼古丁。
words.en: Nicotine is a toxic colorless or yellowish oily liquid that is the chief active constituent of tobacco. It acts as a stimulant in small doses, but in larger amounts blocks the action of autonomic nerve and skeletal muscle cells.

words.tr: n. 几率；不利条件；不平等；
words.ex: The odds of winning the lottery are very low.
words.ex_cn: 中彩票的几率非常低。
words.en: The odds are the chances that a particular thing will happen.

words.tr: v. 供氧，输氧；（使）用氧饱和；（使）富氧；氧化; n. 氧化物
words.ex: The nurse oxygenate the patient with a mask.
words.ex_cn: 护士用面罩为病人输氧。
words.en: To oxygenate something means to add oxygen to it, often in order to make it healthier or more effective.

words.ex: He used paraffin to light the lamp.
words.ex_cn: 他用煤油点亮了灯。
words.en: A white or colorless, tasteless, odorless, waxy solid derived from petroleum, coal, or shale oil, used in candles, wax paper, polishes, and sealing materials.

words.ex: The car runs on petroleum.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车使用石油运行。
words.en: A naturally occurring, yellow-to-black liquid found in geological formations beneath the Earth's surface, which is commonly refined into various types of fuels.

words.ex: The needle will pierce the skin.
words.ex_cn: 针会刺穿皮肤。
words.en: If a sharp object pierces something, or if you pierce something with a sharp object, the object goes into it and makes a hole in it.

words.tr:
n. 毛孔；小孔
v. 细看；钻研；凝视
words.ex: Sweat comes out through the pores of the skin.
words.ex_cn: 汗水通过皮肤上的毛孔排出。
words.en: A pore is a tiny opening in a surface that allows liquids or gases to pass through. As a verb, to pore means to read or study something very carefully.

words.tr: adj. 预制的 n. 活动房屋
words.ex: They live in a prefab house due to the recent natural disaster.
words.ex_cn: 由于最近的自然灾害，他们住在一所预制房屋里。
words.en: Prefab refers to something that is manufactured in sections to enable quick assembly and easy transport.

words.tr:
n. 抛射物；射弹；发射物；自动推进武器
adj. 发射的；射弹的；推进的
words.ex: The boy threw a projectile into the air.
words.ex_cn: 男孩把一个抛射物扔向空中。
words.en: A projectile is an object that is thrown or shot forwards, such as a bullet fired from a gun.

words.ex: He wears a protective helmet when he rides a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车时戴一顶保护性的头盔。
words.en: If something is protective, it is intended to protect someone or something from harm or damage.

words.tr:
n. 释放；发布；
v. 释放；发布；
words.ex: The release of the prisoner made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯的释放让每个人都高兴。
words.en: To release something means to let it go or to allow it to be free, or to make something available to the public.

words.ex: The smell repels insects.
words.ex_cn: 这种气味能击退昆虫。
words.en: If something repels you, it is so unpleasant or offensive that you want to avoid it or push it away.

words.ex: The tree produces a sticky resin.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树会分泌一种粘稠的树脂。
words.en: A sticky substance secreted by some trees, used in varnishes, adhesives, and plastics.

words.ex: He scratched his scalp because it was itchy.
words.ex_cn: 他挠头皮，因为那里发痒。
words.en: The skin covering the top of the human head, or a trophy taken by cutting off the scalp of an enemy.

words.tr:
v. 刮；擦；刮出刺耳声；勉强通过
n. 刮；擦；擦痕；刮擦声
words.ex: He scraped his knee on the rough ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在粗糙的地面上擦伤了膝盖。
words.en: To remove something from a surface using a sharp or rough edge, or to injure a part of the body by rubbing it against a rough surface.

words.ex: The skull protects the brain.
words.ex_cn: 颅骨保护大脑。
words.en: The bony framework of the head that encloses the brain and supports the structures of the face.

words.ex: The water will solidify when it gets very cold.
words.ex_cn: 水在非常冷的时候会变凝固。
words.en: If something solidifies or is solidified, it becomes solid or hard.

words.tr:
n. 注射器；注水器；洗涤器
v. 注射；（用注水器）灌溉
words.ex: The nurse used a syringe to give him a shot.
words.ex_cn: 护士用注射器给他打了一针。
words.en: A syringe is a small tube with a thin hollow needle at the end. Syringes are used for putting liquids into things and for taking liquids out, for example for injecting drugs or for taking blood from someone's body.

words.tr:
v. 移栽；移植；
n. 移植；
words.ex: He will transplant the flowers to the garden tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要把这些花移栽到花园里。
words.en: To transplant something means to move it from one place to another. In medicine, to transplant an organ, piece of skin, etc. means to use it to replace a damaged part in someone's body.

words.tr: n. 宽四寸厚二尺的木材; adj. （尤指建筑物）小的；长宽为二寸与四寸的
words.ex: He used a two-by-four to reinforce the structure.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根二乘四的木材来加固结构。
words.en: A piece of wood that measures two inches by four inches, typically used in construction.

words.tr: adj. 正在进行中的；航行中的；
words.ex: The project is underway.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正在进行中。
words.en: If something is underway, it is happening now.

words.tr: int. 瞧！（表示事情完成或达到预期）
words.ex: Voilà, your coffee is ready.
words.ex_cn: 瞧，你的咖啡好了。
words.en: used to call attention, to express satisfaction or approval, or to suggest an appearance as if by magic

words.ex: The weather is sunny today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气晴朗。
words.en: The condition of the atmosphere at a particular place and time, especially with regard to temperature, precipitation, and wind.

words.ex: The bridge can withstand strong winds.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥能经受住强风。
words.en: If something or someone withstands a force or action, they survive it or do not give in to it.

chapters.name: Unit 4 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 集中注意于；依附于；紧盯着
words.ex: The child fastened on the candy and didn't want to let go.
words.ex_cn: 孩子紧紧抓住糖果，不想放手。
words.en: To attach or fix something firmly to something else; to focus one's attention or efforts on something.

words.ex: He cooked dinner; meantime, the kids did their homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做晚饭；与此同时，孩子们在做作业。
words.en: The time between one event and another; meanwhile.

words.tr: phrase. 把…注入；把…注射到；将…投入；引入
words.ex: He will inject the medicine into the patient's arm.
words.ex_cn: 他将把药注入病人的手臂。
words.en: To introduce something, such as an idea or substance, into a system or environment.

words.ex: He will recover from the flu next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会从流感中康复。
words.en: To recover from something means to return to a normal state of health, mind, or strength after experiencing an illness, injury, or emotional distress.

words.tr: phrase. 滑过；忽略；回避（问题或责任）
words.ex: She tried to slide over the difficult topic.
words.ex_cn: 她试图回避这个棘手的话题。
words.en: To move smoothly over a surface while touching it, or to move something in this way.

words.ex: The pendulum moves to and fro.
words.ex_cn: 钟摆来回摆动。
words.en: Moving repeatedly from one place to another and back again.

words.ex: He watches for the bus every morning at 7.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上七点守候公交车。
words.en: To be alert and look out for something or someone.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Text A New Words

words.ex: The adopter was delighted to finally bring the child home.
words.ex_cn: 养父母终于把孩子带回家，感到非常高兴。
words.en: An adopter is a person or organization that starts to use something new, such as a new technology or a new idea.

words.ex: His family's affluence allowed him to travel the world.
words.ex_cn: 他家的富裕让他能环游世界。
words.en: Affluence is the state of having a lot of money or owning many things.

words.ex: The affluent family bought a big house by the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这个富裕的家庭在湖边买了一栋大房子。
words.en: Having a great deal of money; wealthy.

words.ex: The analyst studied the data carefully.
words.ex_cn: 这位分析者仔细研究了数据。
words.en: An analyst is a person whose job is to analyze a subject and give opinions about it.

words.tr: adj. 人口统计的；人口的；
words.ex: The survey collected demographic data like age and income.
words.ex_cn: 这项调查收集了年龄和收入等人口统计数据。
words.en: Relating to the structure of populations.

words.tr: adj. 分离的； v. 脱离；拆卸；分离；“detach”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The house is detached from the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子与邻居的房子是分开的。
words.en: If someone is detached, they do not have any emotional interest in a situation and therefore can make fair decisions.

words.ex: The diode lets electricity flow in one direction.
words.ex_cn: 这个二极管允许电流单向流动。
words.en: A diode is a device that allows current to flow in one direction only.

words.ex: The lamp emits a soft light.
words.ex_cn: 灯发出柔和的光。
words.en: To emit means to send out something such as light, heat, sound, gas, etc.

words.ex: The bonus is an incentive to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 奖金是努力工作的动机。
words.en: Something that encourages a person to do something or to work harder.

words.ex: Sugar is an ingredient in this cake.
words.ex_cn: 糖是这个蛋糕的一个成分。
words.en: An ingredient is one of the substances that are combined to make something, especially in cooking.

words.tr:
n. 租契；
v. 出租；
words.ex: He signed a lease for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租契。
words.en: A lease is a legal agreement by which the owner of a building, a piece of land, or something such as a car allows someone else to use it for a period of time in return for money.

words.ex: The miser saved all his money and never spent it.
words.ex_cn: 这个吝啬鬼把所有的钱都存起来，从不花掉。
words.en: A miser is a person who is extremely unwilling to spend money, often to the point of living in poverty despite having wealth.

words.ex: Her motto is 'Never give up.'
words.ex_cn: 她的座右铭是‘永不放弃’。
words.en: A motto is a short sentence or phrase that expresses a rule for sensible behavior, especially a way of behaving in a particular situation.

words.ex: The rain offset the heat yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天的雨抵消了炎热。
words.en: If one thing is offset by another, the effect of the first thing is reduced by the second, so that any advantage or disadvantage is cancelled out.

words.tr: v. 供应；提供；报价；“offer”的现在分词； n. 出售物；作品；
words.ex: The store is offering fresh vegetables every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每天早上供应新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: An offering is something that is produced for other people to use, watch, or enjoy, or the act of producing it.

words.ex: The new car can outpace the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这辆新车能超过旧车。
words.en: To outpace someone or something means to perform a particular action faster or better than they do.

words.tr:
adv. 彻底地；立刻地；
adj. 完全的；彻底的；
words.ex: He refused the offer outright.
words.ex_cn: 他彻底拒绝了这个提议。
words.en: If something is done outright, it is done completely and without any hesitation or attempt to hide it.

words.tr:
n. 音高；球场；程度（最高点）；宣传论点；
v. 扎营；
words.ex: The singer changed the pitch of her voice.
words.ex_cn: 歌手改变了她声音的音高。
words.en: Pitch can refer to the highness or lowness of a sound, the act of throwing something, or a thick, black, sticky substance used for paving roads or waterproofing.

words.ex: The production of polysilicon has increased significantly in recent years.
words.ex_cn: 近年来，多晶硅的生产量显著增加。
words.en: Polysilicon is a high purity form of silicon used as a raw material by the solar photovoltaic and electronics industry.

words.ex: He is presumably at home now.
words.ex_cn: 推测起来，他现在在家。
words.en: If you say that something is presumably the case, you mean that you think it is very likely to be the case, although you are not certain.

words.ex: I need to recharge my phone.
words.ex_cn: 我需要给我的手机再充电。
words.en: To charge a battery or device again; to regain energy or vitality.

words.ex: He worked hard to recoup his losses.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以重获损失的资金。
words.en: To recoup means to regain something lost or to compensate for something, especially money or losses.

words.ex: They decided to refinance their mortgage to get a lower interest rate.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定重新贷款以获得较低的利率。
words.en: To obtain a new loan to pay off an existing loan, typically under different terms, especially to take advantage of lower interest rates.

words.tr: v. 重新包装；使面目一新
words.ex: The company decided to repackage its products to attract more customers.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定重新包装其产品以吸引更多客户。
words.en: To repackage something means to package it again in a different way, often in order to make it more attractive or easier to sell.

words.ex: He lives in a residential area near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一个住宅区。
words.en: Relating to or suitable for residence.

words.ex: He works in retail at a small store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小店从事零售工作。
words.en: The sale of goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.ex: The road rises steeply up the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这条路大坡度地向上延伸到山上。
words.en: In a manner that is steep; sharply or abruptly.

words.tr: adj. 非官方的；非正式的；未经正式批准的
words.ex: The meeting was held as an unofficial gathering.
words.ex_cn: 这次会议是以非正式聚会的形式举行的。
words.en: Not officially authorized or confirmed.

words.ex: The remote village is unreachable by road during the rainy season.
words.ex_cn: 这个偏远村庄在雨季期间无法通过道路到达。
words.en: If you describe something as unreachable, you mean that it cannot be reached, accessed, or achieved.

words.ex: You need to pay the upfront fee before the service starts.
words.ex_cn: 你需要在服务开始前支付预付款。
words.en: If you are upfront about something, you are honest and open about it.

words.ex: The usage of this machine is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器的使用非常简单。
words.en: The way in which something is used or the fact of being used.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 有资格的；具备条件的；符合资格做某事的
words.ex: Only members who have paid their dues are eligible to vote in the election.
words.ex_cn: 只有已经缴纳会费的会员才有资格在选举中投票。
words.en: To have the right to do or obtain something; fulfill the necessary conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 打成平手；得失相当
words.ex: After selling 100 tickets, the theater broke even.
words.ex_cn: 卖了100张票后，剧院打成了平手。
words.en: To reach a point in a business where the costs and the revenue are equal, so that there is neither profit nor loss.

words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.tr: phrase. 抬高；迫使...上升；驱车来到
words.ex: The shortage of apples will drive up the price.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的短缺会抬高价格。
words.en: To cause something to increase in amount or level, especially prices or costs.

words.tr: phrase. v. 戴上；套上（通常指衣物或配件合适地穿或戴）
words.ex: She went to the store to fit on some new dresses.
words.ex_cn: 她去商店试穿了一些新裙子。
words.en: To try on clothes or shoes to see if they are the right size or suitable.

words.tr: phrase. v. 迫不及待地抓住；欣然接受；急忙抓住（机会、提议等）
words.ex: He will jump at the chance to travel abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他会迫不及待地抓住出国旅行的机会。
words.en: To eagerly accept an opportunity or offer.

words.tr: phrase. 处于（某领域）最前沿；引领（技术或潮流）尖端
words.ex: The company is on the cutting edge of technology.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司处于科技的最前沿。
words.en: If you are at the cutting edge of a particular field of activity, you are involved in its most advanced or most exciting developments.

words.tr: phrase. 放下；记下；镇压；贬低；削减；杀死
words.ex: He put down his pen and smiled.
words.ex_cn: 他放下笔，笑了。
words.en: To place something on a surface or in a particular position; to write something down; to suppress or end something by force; to criticize someone in a way that makes them seem stupid or unimportant.

words.tr: phrase. 签约受雇；签约雇佣；开始广播
words.ex: He signs on to the new job next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周正式加入新工作。
words.en: To agree to become an employee; to start broadcasting.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Text B New Words

words.ex: The forest has abundant water and trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林水源和树木都很丰富。
words.en: If something is abundant, there is a lot of it or it is very common.

words.ex: The car will accelerate when you press the gas.
words.ex_cn: 当你踩油门时，汽车会加速。
words.en: To accelerate means to start to go faster or to make something start to go faster.

words.ex: The adverse weather delayed the flight.
words.ex_cn: 不利的天气延误了航班。
words.en: If something is adverse, it is harmful or unfavorable.

words.ex: The bacterial infection made him very sick.
words.ex_cn: 细菌感染让他病得很重。
words.en: Relating to or caused by bacteria.

words.ex: The car runs on biofuel.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车使用生物燃料行驶。
words.en: Biofuel is a type of energy derived from renewable biological sources, such as plants or animal waste, used as an alternative to fossil fuels.

words.ex: The farm uses cow waste to make biogas.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场用牛粪制造沼气。
words.en: Biogas is a type of biofuel that is naturally produced from the decomposition of organic waste.

words.ex: The wind turns the blade of the fan.
words.ex_cn: 风转动了风扇的叶片。
words.en: The flat cutting part of a tool or weapon, such as a knife or sword.

words.ex: The factory makes cheese, and whey is a by-product.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂生产奶酪，乳清是副产品。
words.en: A by-product is something that is produced as a result of making something else, or something unexpected that happens as a result of something.

words.tr: n. 藻井; （水下作业用的）沉箱; 沉雷箱
words.ex: The workers used a caisson to dig the underwater tunnel.
words.ex_cn: 工人们使用沉箱挖掘水下隧道。
words.en: A caisson is a large watertight chamber, open at the bottom, from which the water is kept out by air pressure and in which construction work may be carried out under water.

words.ex: He uses a calculator to add numbers.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算器来加数字。
words.en: A calculator is a small electronic device that you use for doing mathematical calculations.

words.ex: He is a carrier of the flu virus.
words.ex_cn: 他是流感病毒的携带者。
words.en: A carrier is a person or thing that carries, holds, or conveys something.

words.ex: The combustion of wood produces heat and smoke.
words.ex_cn: 木材的燃烧会产生热量和烟雾。
words.en: Combustion is a chemical process in which a substance reacts with oxygen to give off heat and light.

words.ex: He wears conventional clothes to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿传统服装去上班。
words.en: Conventional ideas, methods, or systems are the ones that are generally accepted and used, and that have been used for a long time.

words.ex: The earth's crust is made of rock.
words.ex_cn: 地球的地壳由岩石组成。
words.en: The crust is the hard outer layer of something, such as bread or the Earth's surface.

words.tr: adj. 圆柱形的；圆筒状的；
words.ex: The glass has a cylindrical shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃杯是圆柱形的。
words.en: Something that is cylindrical is in the shape of a cylinder.

words.ex: The dam holds back the river water.
words.ex_cn: 水坝拦住了河水。
words.en: A dam is a barrier that stops or restricts the flow of water or underground streams. Reservoirs created by dams not only suppress floods but also provide water for activities such as irrigation, human consumption, industrial use, aquaculture, and navigability.

words.ex: The apple will decompose in the soil.
words.ex_cn: 苹果会在土壤中分解。
words.en: If something decomposes, or if it is decomposed, it decays or breaks down into smaller parts or substances.

words.ex: The pollution caused the degradation of the river.
words.ex_cn: 污染导致了河流的恶化。
words.en: The process by which something is reduced in quality, value, or status.

words.ex: The depletion of natural resources is a serious problem.
words.ex_cn: 自然资源的损耗是一个严重的问题。
words.en: The act of reducing something by a large amount so that there is not enough left.

words.ex: The teacher designated him as the group leader.
words.ex_cn: 老师指派他为组长。
words.en: If you designate someone or something as a particular thing, you formally give them that description or name.

words.ex: The disposal of waste is important for the environment.
words.ex_cn: 废物的处理对环境很重要。
words.en: The act or process of getting rid of something, especially by throwing it away or selling it.

words.ex: The dissipation of energy in the system led to a decrease in efficiency.
words.ex_cn: 系统中能量的损耗导致了效率的下降。
words.en: The process by which energy or matter is gradually lost and becomes less concentrated, or the act of wasting money, time, or energy in a careless way.

words.ex: The factory reduces emission to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 工厂减少排放以保护环境。
words.en: An emission is the production and discharge of something, especially gas or radiation.

words.ex: I envisage a world without war.
words.ex_cn: 我设想一个没有战争的世界。
words.en: If you envisage something, you imagine that it is true, real, or likely to happen.

words.tr:
n. 过量；过度；超过；
adj. 多余的；
words.ex: The excess of sugar in his diet caused health problems.
words.ex_cn: 他饮食中糖分过量导致了健康问题。
words.en: An excess of something is a larger amount than is needed, allowed, or usual.

words.ex: Oil is an exhaustible resource.
words.ex_cn: 石油是一种用得尽的资源。
words.en: If something is exhaustible, it can be used up completely.

words.ex: The exploitation of natural resources helps the economy grow.
words.ex_cn: 自然资源的开发有助于经济发展。
words.en: The action or fact of treating someone unfairly in order to benefit from their work, or the utilization of something for profit or gain.

words.tr: n. 设施；特色功能；特定场所；资质；
words.ex: The school has a new sports facility.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个新的体育设施。
words.en: A facility is a place, building, or service that is designed for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 深远的；影响深远的
words.ex: The decision had far-reaching effects on the town.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定对这个城镇产生了深远的影响。
words.en: If you describe actions, events, or changes as far-reaching, you mean that they have a very great influence and affect a great number of things.

words.ex: The town uses geothermal energy to heat homes.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇利用地热能为房屋供暖。
words.en: Geothermal refers to the heat that comes from the sub-surface of the earth. It is contained in the rocks and fluids beneath the earth's crust and can be found as far down as to the earth's hot molten rock, magma.

words.ex: The rain was a hindrance to the game.
words.ex_cn: 雨水对比赛造成了妨碍。
words.en: A hindrance is a person or thing that makes it difficult for you to do something.

words.ex: The dam produces hydroelectric power for the city.
words.ex_cn: 这座水坝为城市提供水力发电。
words.en: Relating to the generation of electricity by the force of fast-moving water, such as rivers or waterfalls.

words.ex: Hydrogen is the lightest element.
words.ex_cn: 氢是最轻的元素。
words.en: Hydrogen is a chemical element with symbol H and atomic number 1. With a standard atomic weight of 1.008, hydrogen is the lightest element in the periodic table.

words.ex: He will inevitably fail if he doesn't study.
words.ex_cn: 如果他不学习，他不可避免地会失败。
words.en: If something will inevitably happen, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

words.tr: adj. 用不完的；无穷无尽的；
words.ex: The sun provides an inexhaustible source of energy.
words.ex_cn: 太阳提供一种用不完的能量来源。
words.en: If you describe something as inexhaustible, you are emphasizing that there is a very large quantity of it and that it is not likely to be used up or to run out.

words.tr: v. 使隔热；“insulate”的现在分词； adj. 绝缘的；
words.ex: The walls are insulating the house from cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁使房子隔绝了寒冷天气。
words.en: Preventing the passage of heat, electricity, or sound; isolating from others.

words.ex: The kinetic energy of the moving ball is high.
words.ex_cn: 运动的球的动能很高。
words.en: Relating to or resulting from motion.

words.tr: n. 垃圾填埋（场）；垃圾堆填（区）；
words.ex: The city built a new landfill outside the town.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市在城外建了一个新的垃圾填埋场。
words.en: A landfill is a place where waste is buried under the ground.

words.ex: The old mill stands by the river.
words.ex_cn: 旧磨坊坐落在河边。
words.en: A mill is a building in which grain is crushed to make flour. It can also refer to a factory where certain materials are processed or manufactured.

words.tr:
adj. 粒子状的；微粒的
n. 粒子；微粒状物质
words.ex: The air contains particulate matter from smoke.
words.ex_cn: 空气中含有来自烟雾的粒子状物质。
words.en: Relating to or in the form of minute separate particles.

words.tr: adv. 永恒地；持久地；无休止地
words.ex: He is perpetually late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他总是上课迟到。
words.en: If something happens perpetually, it happens all the time or very often.

words.ex: The factory releases a pollutant into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向河里排放一种污染物。
words.en: A pollutant is a substance that pollutes something, especially air, water, or soil.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: The wind propels the sailboat forward.
words.ex_cn: 风推动帆船前进。
words.en: To propel something in a particular direction means to cause it to move in that direction.

words.ex: Children have reliance on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子依赖父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: Reliance is the state of depending on or trusting in someone or something.

words.ex: She replenished the water bottle after the hike.
words.ex_cn: 她在徒步后补充了水瓶里的水。
words.en: If you replenish something, you make it full or complete again.

words.ex: The reservoir provides water for the nearby town.
words.ex_cn: 这个水库为附近的城镇提供水源。
words.en: A reservoir is a large quantity of a substance that is stored and can be used when needed.

words.tr: adj. 呼吸的；与呼吸有关的；
words.ex: The respiratory system helps us breathe.
words.ex_cn: 呼吸系统帮助我们呼吸。
words.en: Relating to or affecting respiration or the organs of respiration.

words.ex: The students have a rotational schedule for cleaning the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 学生们轮流负责打扫教室。
words.en: Relating to or involving rotation; occurring in turn or sequence.

words.ex: He works in a factory that makes semiconductors.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家生产半导体的工厂工作。
words.en: A semiconductor is a substance that can conduct electricity under some conditions but not others, making it a good medium for the control of electrical current.

words.ex: The rod is a long shaft made of metal.
words.ex_cn: 这根杆是一根长金属杆。
words.en: A shaft is a long, narrow part or section forming the handle of a tool or club, the body of a spear or arrow, or a long, narrow, typically vertical hole that gives access to a mine, accommodates a lift, or provides ventilation.

words.tr: v. 悬浮；暂停；“suspend”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The particles are suspended in water.
words.ex_cn: 这些颗粒悬浮在水中。
words.en: If something is suspended, it is hanging from somewhere or is not moving or active for a period of time.

words.ex: The thermal blanket keeps you warm.
words.ex_cn: 这个保暖毯让你暖和。
words.en: relating to heat or temperature

words.ex: He tightened the screw with a wrench.
words.ex_cn: 他用扳手把螺丝拧紧。
words.en: If you tighten a rule, policy, or system, you make it stricter or more efficient.

words.ex: There was an upsurge in demand for masks during the pandemic.
words.ex_cn: 疫情期间，对口罩的需求激增。
words.en: An upsurge is a sudden and usually large increase in something.

words.ex: The utilization of solar energy is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能的利用正在增加。
words.en: Utilization is the act of using something effectively.

words.ex: We can utilize solar energy to power the house.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以利用太阳能来为房子供电。
words.en: To utilize something means to use it in a practical or effective way.

words.ex: The water vapor rose into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 水蒸气升上了天空。
words.en: Vapor is a substance in the gas phase at a temperature lower than its critical temperature, which means that the vapor can be condensed to a liquid by increasing its pressure without reducing the temperature.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 出路；解决办法；出口
words.ex: We need to find a way out of this financial crisis.
words.ex_cn: n. 我们需要找到摆脱这场金融危机的方法。
words.en: A means of escape or a solution to a problem.

words.ex: People from all walks of life came to the festival.
words.ex_cn: 来自各行各业的人都来参加了这个节日。
words.en: People from all walks of life are people of all types, especially all types of jobs.

words.ex: He lives apart from the city noise.
words.ex_cn: 他住在远离城市喧嚣的地方。
words.en: You use apart from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.tr: adj. 可比较的；比得上的；类似的；
words.ex: The prices of these two phones are comparable.
words.ex_cn: 这两部手机的价格是可比较的。
words.en: Something that is comparable to something else is similar in size, amount, or quality.

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使变热；加热；使变得更激烈
words.ex: The sun will heat up the sand.
words.ex_cn: 太阳会让沙子变热。
words.en: To make something hot or warm.

words.tr: phrase. 相比之下；和...形成对照
words.ex: He likes coffee, in contrast to his sister who likes tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，而他的妹妹喜欢茶。
words.en: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first

words.tr: phrase. 在缺乏…的情况下；在没有…时
words.ex: He left the meeting in the absence of his boss.
words.ex_cn: 在老板不在的情况下，他离开了会议。
words.en: If something happens in the absence of a particular thing, it happens when that thing is not there or when that thing is not available.

words.ex: This room can serve as a meeting room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间可以充当会议室。
words.en: To function or be used as something.

words.tr: phrase. 风力涡轮机；风力发电机
words.ex: The wind turbine generates electricity from the wind.
words.ex_cn: 风力涡轮机利用风力发电。
words.en: A wind turbine is a device that converts the kinetic energy of wind into electrical energy.

chapters.name: Unit 6 Text A New Words

words.ex: The king's abdication was announced yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 国王的退位昨天被宣布了。
words.en: The act of formally relinquishing monarchical authority.

words.ex: The bird flew aloft above the trees.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在树顶上方高飞。
words.en: If something is aloft, it is in the air or off the ground.

words.ex: The asteroid flew past Earth safely.
words.ex_cn: 这颗小行星安全地从地球旁飞过。
words.en: An asteroid is a small rocky body orbiting the sun. Large numbers of these, ranging enormously in size, are found between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter, though some have more eccentric orbits.

words.ex: The astronaut walked on the moon.
words.ex_cn: 这名宇航员在月球上行走。
words.en: An astronaut is a person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft.

words.ex: The atmospheric pressure dropped before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来临前，大气压下降了。
words.en: Relating to the atmosphere of the Earth or another planet; creating a distinctive mood, typically of romance or nostalgia.

words.tr: adv. 非常；很；令人畏惧地
words.ex: The weather is awfully cold today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气冷得厉害。
words.en: Awfully is used to emphasize the degree or extent of something, often implying that it is more than expected or usual.

words.tr: n. 后援者；援助者；升压器；助力器
words.ex: He is a booster of the local football team.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地足球队的后援者。
words.en: A booster is something that increases the power, effectiveness, or success of something else. It can also refer to a person who promotes or supports something enthusiastically.

words.ex: His speech was coherent and easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲连贯且易于理解。
words.en: If something is coherent, it is well planned, so that it is clear and sensible and all its parts go well with each other.

words.tr: v．冷拨：在没有预约或事先联系的情况下，向潜在客户或销售对象拨打电话，以推销产品或服务。
words.ex: The sales team spends most of their day cold-calling potential clients.
words.ex_cn: 销售团队大部分时间都在给潜在客户打冷电话。
words.en: To make an unsolicited visit or telephone call to someone in an attempt to sell goods or services.

words.ex: They want to commercialize the new app.
words.ex_cn: 他们想将这个新应用商业化。
words.en: To commercialize something means to organize or develop it in such a way that it becomes intended to make a profit.

words.ex: The train has a sleeping compartment for passengers.
words.ex_cn: 火车上有一个供乘客休息的隔间。
words.en: A compartment is a separate section or part of something, especially a space in a vehicle that is separated from other spaces.

words.ex: Heat rises through convection in the room.
words.ex_cn: 热量通过空气对流在房间中上升。
words.en: Convection is the process by which heat is transferred by the movement of a fluid, such as air or water, due to the difference in density caused by temperature differences.

words.ex: He loves to watch the cosmos at night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在夜晚观看宇宙。
words.en: The cosmos refers to the universe seen as a well-ordered whole, or to any system or structure that is complex and orderly.

words.ex: The witness lost credibility after lying.
words.ex_cn: 证人因撒谎而失去了可信性。
words.en: The quality of being trusted and believed in.

words.ex: She listened to the story credulously, never doubting its truth.
words.ex_cn: 她轻信地听着这个故事，从未怀疑过它的真实性。
words.en: In a manner that shows too great a readiness to believe things.

words.ex: The sugar formed a crystalline structure.
words.ex_cn: 糖形成了晶状结构。
words.en: Something that is crystalline is clear and transparent like crystal, or is made up of crystals.

words.ex: The internet helps to democratize access to information.
words.ex_cn: 互联网有助于使信息获取更加普及。
words.en: To make something accessible to everyone, especially something that was previously restricted to a particular group of people.

words.tr: vt. 绕射; 使（光）衍射
words.ex: The light diffracts as it passes through the narrow slit.
words.ex_cn: 光通过狭窄的缝隙时会发生衍射。
words.en: To cause (light, sound, etc.) to spread out when passing through a narrow opening or around an obstacle.

words.tr: adj. 遵守纪律的； v. “discipline”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a disciplined student who always arrives on time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个遵守纪律的学生，总是准时到达。
words.en: Someone who is disciplined behaves in a controlled way, obeying rules or standards.

words.ex: The mirror distorts my face.
words.ex_cn: 这面镜子扭曲了我的脸。
words.en: If you distort a statement, fact, or idea, you report or represent it in an untrue way.

words.tr:
adj. 荷兰的；
n. 荷兰人；荷兰语；
words.ex: He ate Dutch cheese for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了荷兰奶酪。
words.en: Dutch refers to anything related to the Netherlands, including its people, language, or culture.

words.ex: The city has great dynamism and always feels alive.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市充满活力，总是生机勃勃。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has dynamism, you are expressing approval of the fact that they are full of energy or full of new and exciting ideas.

words.ex: She completed the task effectively.
words.ex_cn: 她有效地完成了任务。
words.en: In a way that produces the intended result or a successful outcome.

words.tr: v. （使）参与；从事于；雇佣；“engage”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 忙着的；
words.ex: The teacher engaged the students in a group discussion.
words.ex_cn: 老师让学生们参与了一次小组讨论。
words.en: If you are engaged in an activity, you are doing it or involved in it. If you are engaged to someone, you have agreed to marry them.

words.ex: This small enterprise makes handmade toys.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业生产手工玩具。
words.en: An enterprise is a company or business, often a large one, or a difficult or important project, especially one that involves a lot of planning and organization.

words.tr: adj. 充满热情的；热心的；
words.ex: He is enthusiastic about playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他对打篮球充满热情。
words.en: If you are enthusiastic about something, you show how much you like or enjoy it by the way that you behave and talk.

words.tr: adj. 可估量的；值得尊重的
words.ex: The cost of the project is estimable with current data.
words.ex_cn: 根据当前数据，这个项目的成本是可以估量的。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as estimable, you mean that they deserve admiration because they are extremely good or have a very good quality.

words.tr: adj. 可花费的；可消耗的；可牺牲的
words.ex: He is an expendable worker in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是公司里可有可无的员工。
words.en: If someone or something is expendable, people can get rid of them or allow them to be destroyed when they are no longer needed.

words.ex: The exploration of space takes many years.
words.ex_cn: 太空探索需要很多年。
words.en: The act of searching for the purpose of discovery of information or resources.

words.ex: The flaw in the glass made it break easily.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃上的瑕疵让它很容易碎。
words.en: A flaw is a mistake or weakness in something that makes it less effective or valuable.

words.tr: adj. 短暂的； v. “fleet”的现在分词；
words.ex: The smile was fleeting.
words.ex_cn: 那个微笑是短暂的。
words.en: If you describe something as fleeting, you mean that it lasts only for a very short time.

words.ex: The fusion of music and technology creates new sounds.
words.ex_cn: 音乐与技术的融合创造了新的声音。
words.en: The process or result of joining two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.ex: The picture is fuzzy and hard to see.
words.ex_cn: 这张图片很模糊，看不清楚。
words.en: Something that is fuzzy is unclear or indistinct, often because it is out of focus or because it is covered with a soft, fluffy material.

words.tr: adj. 使人晕眩的；头晕的；轻浮的
words.ex: She felt giddy after spinning around.
words.ex_cn: 她转圈后感到头晕目眩。
words.en: If you feel giddy, you feel unsteady and think that you are about to fall over, usually because you are not well or because you are excited or frightened.

words.tr: adj. （为解决某个问题或做某件事情的）必找的（人）；（为找到某件物品或服务的）必去的（地方）
words.ex: She is the go-to person for all tech issues in the office.
words.ex_cn: 她是办公室里解决所有技术问题的必找之人。
words.en: A person or thing that is the first choice for a particular purpose or situation.

words.ex: The grasshopper jumps high in the grass.
words.ex_cn: 蚱蜢在草丛中跳得很高。
words.en: A grasshopper is a plant-eating insect with long back legs that can jump very high and makes a sharp, high noise using its back legs or wings.

words.ex: He lives on a small homestead with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在一个小农场里。
words.en: A homestead is a house and the land around it, especially a farm.

words.ex: She solved the math problem impressively.
words.ex_cn: 她令人印象深刻地解出了这道数学题。
words.en: In a manner that attracts attention or admiration through being notable or extraordinary.

words.ex: The ad induced him to buy the product.
words.ex_cn: 这则广告诱使他购买了该产品。
words.en: To induce a state or condition means to cause it.

words.ex: He gave a justification for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他为迟到提供了一个正当的理由。
words.en: A justification for something is an acceptable reason or explanation for it.

words.tr: n. 微重力，无重力，失重状态
words.ex: In space, astronauts experience microgravity.
words.ex_cn: 在太空中，宇航员会经历微重力状态。
words.en: Microgravity is the condition in which people or objects appear to be weightless. The effects of microgravity can be seen when astronauts and objects float in space.

words.tr: n. 采矿；采矿业； v. “mine”的现在分词；
words.ex: Mining is an important industry in this region.
words.ex_cn: 采矿是这个地区的重要产业。
words.en: Mining is the process of extracting minerals and other materials from the earth.

words.ex: He is mostly late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他主要迟到上课。
words.en: You use mostly to indicate that a statement is generally true, for example true about most of a group of things or people, true most of the time, or true in most situations.

words.tr:
n. 樟脑丸；卫生球
v. 束之高阁；封存
words.ex: She put mothballs in the drawer to keep clothes safe.
words.ex_cn: 她把樟脑丸放在抽屉里以保护衣物。
words.en: A mothball is a small ball made of a chemical substance which has a strong smell. It is used to keep moths away from clothes. In a figurative sense, to mothball something means to postpone or cancel a plan or project.

words.ex: The company's focus is on near-term profitability.
words.ex_cn: 公司的重点是短期盈利能力。
words.en: Relating to or occurring in the near future; short-term.

words.ex: He raised an objection to the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他对新规定提出了反对。
words.en: An objection is an expression or feeling of disapproval or opposition; a reason for disagreeing.

words.tr:
n. 轨道；
v. 绕...轨道而行；
words.ex: The moon moves around the Earth in an orbit.
words.ex_cn: 月亮围绕地球在轨道上运行。
words.en: An orbit is the curved path, usually elliptical, described by a planet, satellite, spaceship, etc., around a celestial body, as the sun.

words.ex: I touched the hot stove and said, 'Ouch!'
words.ex_cn: 我碰到了热炉子，说：‘哎哟！’
words.en: used to express sudden pain

words.ex: The pathogen caused the outbreak of the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种病原体引发了疾病的爆发。
words.en: A pathogen is any organism or substance, especially a microorganism, capable of causing disease, such as bacteria, viruses, protozoa, or fungi.

words.ex: The machine makes a perpetual noise.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器发出持续的噪音。
words.en: Something that is perpetual continues indefinitely or for a very long time without interruption.

words.tr: n. 佩奥特掌（仙人掌的一种）
words.ex: The peyote cactus is used in some Native American religious ceremonies.
words.ex_cn: 佩奥特掌仙人掌在一些美洲原住民的宗教仪式中被使用。
words.en: Peyote is a small, spineless cactus that contains psychoactive alkaloids, particularly mescaline. It is native to Mexico and southwestern Texas and has been used traditionally in Native American religious ceremonies.

words.ex: The phoenix rises from its ashes.
words.ex_cn: 凤凰从灰烬中重生。
words.en: A phoenix is a mythical bird that is said to be cyclically regenerated or reborn. Associated with the sun, a phoenix obtains new life by arising from the ashes of its predecessor.

words.ex: The presidential speech was broadcast on TV.
words.ex_cn: 总统的演讲在电视上播出。
words.en: Relating to a president or presidency.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.tr: n. 宣传员；广告人员；公关；经纪人
words.ex: She worked as a publicist for a major publishing house.
words.ex_cn: 她为一家大型出版社担任宣传人员。
words.en: A publicist is someone whose job is to manage the publicity for a well-known person or organization.

words.ex: The reed grows near the river.
words.ex_cn: 芦苇长在河边。
words.en: A reed is a tall, thin plant that grows in water or marshy ground.

words.tr: n. 代表；推销员；销售代表；发言人；
words.ex: He is the rep for our team.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们团队的代表。
words.en: A rep is a person who acts on behalf of a group or organization, especially in selling products or services.

words.ex: The senator speaks to the people every week.
words.ex_cn: 这位参议员每周都对人民讲话。
words.en: A senator is a member of a senate, which is a governing body in many countries, especially in the United States.

words.tr: n. 往返移动之物；航天飞机；
words.ex: The bus is a shuttle between the hotel and the airport.
words.ex_cn: 这辆巴士是酒店和机场之间的往返交通工具。
words.en: A shuttle is a vehicle that travels frequently between two places. In weaving, a shuttle is a device used to carry the weft thread back and forth across the loom.

words.tr: n. 怀疑论者；怀疑宗教主张的人；无神论者
words.ex: He is a skeptic about new health claims.
words.ex_cn: 他对新的健康说法持怀疑态度。
words.en: A skeptic is a person who questions the validity or authenticity of something purporting to be factual.

words.ex: He explained the rules specifically.
words.ex_cn: 他具体地解释了规则。
words.en: You use specifically to emphasize that something is given special attention and considered separately from other things of the same kind.

words.ex: He is stubborn and won't change his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他很顽固，不肯改变主意。
words.en: Someone who is stubborn is determined to do what they want and is very unwilling to change their mind.

words.tr:
n. 目标；对象；
v. 以…为目标；
words.ex: His target is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A target is something at which someone is aiming a weapon or other object.

words.ex: He uses titanium for his bicycle frame.
words.ex_cn: 他用钛来做他的自行车架。
words.en: Titanium is a strong, low-density, highly corrosion-resistant transition metal with a silver color.

words.tr: v. 兜售；招徕；吹捧；倒卖（高价票）
words.ex: He touts the new phone as the best on the market.
words.ex_cn: 他吹捧这款新手机是市场上最好的。
words.en: If someone touts something, they try to sell it or convince people that it is good, especially in an aggressive or exaggerated way.

words.tr: n. 保证；事业； v. 承担；从事；“undertake”的现在分词；
words.ex: He gave an undertaking to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他保证按时完成项目。
words.en: An undertaking is a task or project, especially one that is important or difficult.

words.ex: I clicked the button to undo my mistake.
words.ex_cn: 我点击了按钮来撤销我的错误。
words.en: To undo something means to reverse the effect of a previous action or to untie or unfasten something.

words.ex: The virus made many people sick.
words.ex_cn: 这个病毒让很多人病了。
words.en: A virus is a very small organism that causes infectious diseases in people, animals, and plants.

words.tr:
v. 争论；争执；吵架
n. 争吵；口角
words.ex: They wrangle over the price every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天为价格争执。
words.en: If you wrangle with someone, you argue with them in a noisy or angry way.

words.ex: The astronauts experienced zero-g during their spacewalk.
words.ex_cn: 宇航员在太空行走时体验到了失重状态。
words.en: A condition of weightlessness, especially in space, where the force of gravity is negligible.

chapters.name: Unit 6 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: 短语. 一小部分；少部分
words.ex: He paid a fraction of the price.
words.ex_cn: 他只付了价格的一小部分。
words.en: A very small part or amount of something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 表现自己；使自己表现良好（尤指在困难情况下）
words.ex: He acquitted himself well in the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他在面试中表现得很好。
words.en: To behave or perform in a specified way.

words.ex: He is at work right now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在工作。
words.en: If someone is at work, they are doing their job or are busy doing a particular activity.

words.tr: phrase. 根据大家所说； 人人都这样说
words.ex: By all accounts, she is a very talented musician.
words.ex_cn: 据大家所说，她是一位非常有才华的音乐家。
words.en: According to what everyone says.

words.tr: phrase. 快速而粗略的游览；走马观花式的参观
words.ex: We only had time for a cook's tour of the city.
words.ex_cn: 我们只有时间匆匆游览一下这座城市。
words.en: A quick and superficial tour or survey of a place or topic.

words.tr: phrase. 使自己与众不同；表现突出；出人头地
words.ex: He worked hard to distinguish himself at school.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，想在学校里脱颖而出。
words.en: To distinguish oneself means to do something very well or to be recognized for one's achievements, thereby making oneself stand out from others.

words.tr: phrase. 不挂断；稍等 ；紧紧抓住
words.ex: Hang on, I will be there soon.
words.ex_cn: 等一下，我马上就到。
words.en: To hold onto something tightly; to wait for a short time.

words.tr: phrase. 与生俱来的；天生就有的；融入某人血脉的（指某种特质、天赋或兴趣深植于某人本性中）
words.ex: The passion for music is in her blood.
words.ex_cn: 对音乐的热爱是她血液中的一部分。
words.en: If a quality or ability is in someone's blood, it is a natural part of them, often because of their family background.

words.ex: In the wake of the storm, the city was left in ruins.
words.ex_cn: 风暴过后，城市变成了一片废墟。
words.en: Following immediately after, often as a result of.

words.tr: phrase. 陈述并证明自己的观点；提出自己的论据
words.ex: He made his case with clear examples.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的例子陈述了自己的观点。
words.en: To present one's arguments or reasons in support of something.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.tr: 短语. 在伸手可及的范围内；能够得到的
words.ex: The water is within reach.
words.ex_cn: 水在伸手可及的地方。
words.en: If something is within reach, it is near enough for you to touch or get it easily.

chapters.name: Unit 6 Text B New Words

words.tr: v. 加速；加快；“accelerate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He accelerated the car to pass the truck.
words.ex_cn: 他加速开车超过卡车。
words.en: Increased in speed or happening more quickly than usual.

words.ex: He amass wealth by working hard.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力工作积累财富。
words.en: If you amass something such as money or information, you gradually collect a large amount of it.

words.ex: The king's assassination shocked the whole country.
words.ex_cn: 国王的暗杀震惊了整个国家。
words.en: The act of killing someone important or famous, often for political reasons.

words.ex: The muscle showed signs of atrophy after the injury.
words.ex_cn: 受伤后，肌肉出现了萎缩的迹象。
words.en: Atrophy refers to the wasting away or decrease in size of an organ or tissue, typically as a result of disease, injury, or lack of use.

words.ex: The accident is attributable to poor road conditions.
words.ex_cn: 这起事故可归因于糟糕的路况。
words.en: Capable of being attributed to someone or something.

words.ex: The medicine enters the bloodstream quickly.
words.ex_cn: 药物很快进入血液。
words.en: The bloodstream is the blood flowing in the body's circulatory system.

words.ex: The child blew a bubble with gum.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用口香糖吹了一个气泡。
words.en: A bubble is a small ball of air or gas in a liquid, or a ball of air inside a solid substance such as glass.

words.ex: Milk has a lot of calcium.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶含有大量的钙。
words.en: A chemical element that is present in teeth and bones and is necessary for their health.

words.tr:
n. 毛细血管
adj. 毛细管的；毛细作用的
words.ex: Blood moves through tiny capillary tubes.
words.ex_cn: 血液通过微小的毛细管流动。
words.en: A capillary is a very small blood vessel in the body that connects arteries and veins and allows the exchange of oxygen and nutrients between blood and tissues.

words.ex: The heart is part of the circulatory system.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是循环系统的一部分。
words.en: Relating to the circulation of blood or sap.

words.ex: The colonization of Africa by European countries happened in the 1800s.
words.ex_cn: 欧洲国家对非洲的殖民发生在19世纪。
words.en: The act or process of establishing a colony or colonies.

words.tr: n. 众议院女议员；国会女议员
words.ex: The congresswoman introduced a new bill to support women's rights.
words.ex_cn: 这位国会女议员提出了一项支持妇女权利的新法案。
words.en: A congresswoman is a female member of the United States Congress, especially of the House of Representatives.

words.ex: The cosmic rays come from outer space.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙射线来自外太空。
words.en: Relating to the universe or cosmos, especially as distinct from the earth.

words.ex: The cumulative score is the total of all previous points.
words.ex_cn: 累积得分是所有之前分数的总和。
words.en: If a series of events have a cumulative effect, each event makes the effect greater.

words.ex: The prisoners suffered from sleep deprivation.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯们因睡眠剥夺而受苦。
words.en: Deprivation is the lack or denial of something considered to be a necessity.

words.tr: adj. 扭曲的； v. “distort”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The mirror made her face look distorted.
words.ex_cn: 镜子让她的脸看起来扭曲了。
words.en: If something is distorted, it has been changed from its usual, original, natural, or intended meaning, condition, or shape.

words.ex: The loud noise broke his eardrum.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音震破了他的鼓膜。
words.en: The eardrum is a thin membrane that separates the outer ear from the middle ear and vibrates in response to sound waves.

words.ex: The eventual winner was a young student.
words.ex_cn: 最后的赢家是一位年轻学生。
words.en: An eventual event or situation happens at the end of a process or period of time.

words.tr: adj. 外来的；外国来的；奇异的；
words.ex: The market sells exotic fruits from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场出售来自其他国家的外来水果。
words.en: Something that is exotic is unusual and interesting because it comes from or is related to a distant country.

words.ex: The external wall of the house is painted blue.
words.ex_cn: 房子的外墙被刷成了蓝色。
words.en: External is used to indicate that something is on the outside of a surface or body, or that it exists, happens, or comes from outside.

words.ex: He felt fatigued after running for an hour.
words.ex_cn: 他跑了一小时后感到疲惫。
words.en: Feeling very tired, especially as a result of excessive exertion or lack of sleep.

words.tr:
n. 后续工作；后续事物
adj. 后续的；接着的
words.ex: He made a follow-up call to check on his patient.
words.ex_cn: 他打了一个随访电话来检查病人的状况。
words.en: An action or thing that serves to increase the effectiveness of a previous one, especially a second letter, phone call, or visit.

words.tr: adj. 脆弱的；易碎的；不牢固的；
words.ex: The glass is fragile and might break easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃很脆弱，容易碎。
words.en: If something is fragile, it is easily broken or damaged.

words.tr:
n. 紧身褡；腰带；围绕物
v. 以腰带束缚；围绕
words.ex: She wore a girdle to look slimmer.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条束腰裙来显得更苗条。
words.en: A girdle is a piece of women's underwear that fits tightly around the stomach, hips, and bottom.

words.ex: Heredity determines eye color in humans.
words.ex_cn: 遗传决定人类的眼睛颜色。
words.en: Heredity is the process by which features and characteristics are passed on from parents to their children before the children are born.

words.tr:
adj. 高姿态的；高调的；备受关注的
n. 高姿态；明确的立场
words.ex: He is a high-profile politician who often appears on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位高姿态的政客，经常在电视上出现。
words.en: If someone or something is high-profile, they attract a lot of attention or publicity.

words.ex: He has hypertension and takes medicine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他有高血压，每天吃药。
words.en: Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the artery walls is too high.

words.tr: adj. 入境的；归本国的；回内地的; n. 入站
words.ex: The inbound flight arrives at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 到达航班晚上8点到达。
words.en: An inbound flight or vehicle is one that is arriving at a place rather than leaving it.

words.tr: v. 使充气（于轮胎、气球等）( inflate的现在分词 ); （使）膨胀; （使）通货膨胀; 物
words.ex: The process of inflating the balloon took several minutes.
words.ex_cn: 给气球充气花了好几分钟。
words.en: To inflate something means to make it larger or more important than it really is, especially in a way that is not honest or fair.

words.ex: The pressure was measured in kilopascals.
words.ex_cn: 压力以千帕为单位进行测量。
words.en: A unit of pressure equal to one thousand pascals.

words.ex: The poison is lethal to humans.
words.ex_cn: 这种毒药对人类是致命的。
words.en: Something that is lethal can kill people or animals.

words.tr:
adj. 火星的；
n. 火星人；
words.ex: The martian soil is red and dusty.
words.ex_cn: 火星的土壤是红色且多尘的。
words.en: Relating to the planet Mars or its hypothetical inhabitants.

words.ex: A bright meteor flashed across the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 一颗明亮的流星划过夜空。
words.en: A meteor is a piece of rock or metal that burns very brightly when it enters the earth's atmosphere from space.

words.ex: He took a mouthful of soup.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了一口汤。
words.en: A mouthful is an amount of food or drink that you put into your mouth at one time.

words.tr: adj. 泥泞的；模糊不清的；
words.ex: The road became muddy after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后，这条路变得泥泞。
words.en: If something is muddy, it is covered in mud or full of mud. If you muddy something, you make it muddy or you make it less clear or more complicated.

words.ex: This nifty app helps me learn English every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个极好的应用程序每天帮助我学习英语。
words.en: Something that is nifty is particularly good, clever, or effective.

words.ex: Vegetables are rich in nutrient.
words.ex_cn: 蔬菜富含营养物。
words.en: A nutrient is a substance that is essential for life and growth, such as the vitamins and minerals in food.

words.tr: adj. 以…为导向的； v. “orient”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The program is student-oriented.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目是以学生为导向的。
words.en: If someone is oriented towards or oriented to a particular thing or person, they are mainly concerned with that thing or person.

words.ex: The airline offers special fares for outbound flights.
words.ex_cn: 航空公司为出境航班提供特价票。
words.en: An outbound journey is one that is going away from a particular place.

words.tr: v. 使预先有倾向；使易接受；使易于患（病）
words.ex: Genes can predispose a person to diabetes.
words.ex_cn: 基因可能使人更容易患糖尿病。
words.en: If something predisposes you to think or behave in a particular way, it makes it likely that you will think or behave in that way.

words.ex: The sun gives off radiation.
words.ex_cn: 太阳发出辐射。
words.en: Radiation is energy that comes from a source and travels through space at the speed of light. This energy has an electric field and a magnetic field associated with it, and has wave-like properties. You could also call radiation 'electromagnetic waves'.

words.ex: The remainder of the cake was given to the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的剩余部分给了邻居。
words.en: The remainder is what is left over after other parts have been taken away or used.

words.ex: The rain rendered the road slippery.
words.ex_cn: 雨水使道路变得滑溜。
words.en: To render something means to cause it to become or to provide it. It can also mean to express or translate something.

words.ex: He is a scientist of great renown.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位享有盛誉的科学家。
words.en: Renown is the state of being known and talked about by many people because of your achievements, qualities, or actions.

words.ex: The rupture in the pipe caused a flood.
words.ex_cn: 管道的破裂导致了洪水。
words.en: A rupture is a severe injury in which an internal part of your body tears or bursts open, or the act of breaking or bursting something.

words.ex: Dogs produce saliva when they smell food.
words.ex_cn: 狗闻到食物时会分泌唾液。
words.en: Saliva is the watery liquid that forms in your mouth and helps you to chew and digest food.

words.ex: Finding my lost keys while walking in the park was pure serendipity.
words.ex_cn: 在公园散步时偶然找到了丢失的钥匙，这真是易遇奇缘的运气。
words.en: The occurrence and development of events by chance in a happy or beneficial way.

words.ex: The skeletal system supports the body.
words.ex_cn: 骨骼系统支撑身体。
words.en: Relating to, or forming a skeleton; very thin or emaciated.

words.ex: The roof is made of slate.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶是由板岩制成的。
words.en: A slate is a fine-grained, foliated, homogeneous metamorphic rock derived from an original shale-type sedimentary rock composed of clay or volcanic ash through low-grade regional metamorphism. It is the finest grained foliated metamorphic rock. Foliation may not correspond to the original sedimentary layering, but instead is in planes perpendicular to the direction of metamorphic compression.

words.tr:
n. 拭子；药签；吸取的液体；抹布；拖把
v. 用拭子拭抹或擦净（某物）；（用拖把、抹布等）擦洗（某物）
words.ex: The nurse uses a swab to clean the wound.
words.ex_cn: 护士用棉签清洁伤口。
words.en: A swab is a small piece of cotton or other absorbent material attached to the end of a stick or wire, used for cleaning wounds or applying medication.

words.ex: He is learning theoretical physics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习理论物理。
words.en: A theoretical study or explanation is based on or uses the ideas and abstract principles of a subject, rather than the practical aspects or uses of it.

words.ex: The doctor examined the tissue under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 医生在显微镜下检查了组织。
words.en: Tissue is a group of cells that have a similar structure and that work together to perform a specific function.

words.ex: The transporter is used to move goods from one place to another.
words.ex_cn: 输送机用于将货物从一个地方运送到另一个地方。
words.en: A transporter is a person or thing that transports goods or people from one place to another.

words.tr: n. 人事不省；意识丧失
words.ex: He fell into unconsciousness after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了意识。
words.en: The state of being unaware of and unable to respond to one's surroundings.

words.ex: The storm caused unprecedented damage.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴造成了前所未有的破坏。
words.en: If something is unprecedented, it has never happened before.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

chapters.name: Unit 6 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 尽管如此；仍然；还是
words.ex: He didn't study, but all the same, he passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有学习，但尽管如此，他还是通过了考试。
words.en: Despite that; nevertheless.

words.tr: phrase. 以……为间隔；每隔一段时间（或距离）
words.ex: The bus stops at regular intervals along the road.
words.ex_cn: 公共汽车沿着道路每隔一段距离就停一次。
words.en: If something happens at intervals, it happens several times with gaps or pauses in between.

words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.ex: He got sick during the course of the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行途中生病了。
words.en: Throughout the duration of a particular period or event.

words.ex: The wind scattered the leaves in all directions.
words.ex_cn: adv. 风把树叶吹得四散。
words.en: In every direction; everywhere around.

words.tr: phrase. 预期；期待；在…之前；为…预先准备
words.ex: He saved money in anticipation of buying a car.
words.ex_cn: 他存钱以预期买一辆车。
words.en: If you do something in anticipation of an event, you do it because you believe that event is going to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 在轨道上；进入轨道运行；处于运行轨道中
words.ex: The satellite is now in orbit around the Earth.
words.ex_cn: 这颗卫星现在在地球轨道上运行。
words.en: In orbit refers to the path followed by an object moving in space around a planet or star, especially a satellite moving around the Earth.

words.tr: phrase. 以……的形式；呈……形状；以……方式
words.ex: The answer is in the form of a number.
words.ex_cn: 答案是以数字的形式给出的。
words.en: used to indicate the way in which something is done or presented

words.tr: phrase. 夺走某人的生命；杀害某人
words.ex: The accident took his life.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故夺走了他的生命。
words.en: To cause someone's death.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Text A New Words

words.ex: He bought a new accessory for his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的手机买了一个新配件。
words.en: An accessory is something such as a bag or piece of jewelry that you wear or carry because it is attractive.

words.tr: v. 自夸；夸耀；自豪地拥有
words.ex: He boasts about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他夸耀自己的新车。
words.en: If someone boasts about something that they have done or that they own, they talk about it very proudly, in a way that other people may find irritating or offensive.

words.ex: The bombardment lasted for three hours.
words.ex_cn: 轰击持续了三个小时。
words.en: The act of attacking a place with bombs continuously and intensively.

words.tr:
v. 挥；舞动；炫耀地显示
n. 挥舞
words.ex: He brandished a knife to scare the thief.
words.ex_cn: 他挥舞着一把刀吓唬小偷。
words.en: If you brandish something, especially a weapon, you wave it about in a threatening way.

words.ex: She was a busty woman with a curvaceous figure.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位胸部丰满、曲线优美的女性。
words.en: Having a large bust; full-bosomed.

words.tr:
adj. 高加索的；白种人的
n. 高加索人,白种人
words.ex: The Caucasian race is often considered a distinct racial group.
words.ex_cn: 高加索人种常被视为一个独立的种族群体。
words.en: A Caucasian is a member of the Caucasian race, which includes people from Europe, North Africa, the Middle East, and India. The term is also used to describe something relating to the Caucasus region.

words.ex: She bought a beautiful china cup at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买了一个漂亮的瓷杯。
words.en: China is a country in East Asia, the world's most populous country, with a population of over 1.4 billion. It is also known for its rich history, culture, and contributions to the world, including the invention of paper, printing, the compass, and gunpowder.

words.tr:
v. 高兴得咯咯笑；哈哈大笑
n. 哈哈大笑；开心地笑
words.ex: He chortled when he saw the funny cat.
words.ex_cn: 他看到那只搞笑的猫时咯咯笑了。
words.en: To laugh in a breathy, gleeful way; chuckle.

words.tr:
v. 握紧；捏紧；咬牙切齿
n. 抓紧；咬紧；抓紧用具
words.ex: He clenched his fist when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个消息时握紧了拳头。
words.en: To close or hold something very tightly, especially in a determined or angry way.

words.tr: n. 特写照片；特写镜头
words.ex: The photographer took a close-up of the flower.
words.ex_cn: 摄影师拍了一张花朵的特写。
words.en: A close-up is a photograph or film image taken at close range and showing the subject on a large scale.

words.ex: His conceit makes him ignore others' advice.
words.ex_cn: 他的自负让他忽视别人的建议。
words.en: An excessively favorable opinion of one's own abilities or worth; vanity.

words.tr:
n. 折痕；皱痕
v. 起皱；弄皱
words.ex: The paper has a deep crease from folding.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸因为折叠而有一道深深的折痕。
words.en: A crease is a line or mark made on cloth or paper when it is folded or crushed.

words.tr: v. 下定义；“define”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 明确的；
words.ex: The teacher defined the word clearly.
words.ex_cn: 老师清楚地给这个词下了定义。
words.en: If something is defined, it is explained or described in a clear and precise way.

words.ex: The storm caused disastrous damage to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴给村庄造成了灾难性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as disastrous, you mean that it is very unfortunate or unsuccessful.

words.ex: He had a dour expression on his face.
words.ex_cn: 他脸上带着严厉的表情。
words.en: If you describe someone as dour, you mean they are very serious and unfriendly.

words.ex: The epidemic spread quickly across the country.
words.ex_cn: 这种流行病迅速蔓延到全国。
words.en: An epidemic is a large number of cases of an infectious disease occurring at the same time.

words.ex: The government raised the excise on tobacco.
words.ex_cn: 政府提高了烟草的货物税。
words.en: Excise is a tax that is charged on goods produced within a country, or on goods that are brought into a country from abroad, especially on goods such as alcohol and tobacco. It can also refer to the act of cutting out or removing something, especially in a surgical operation.

words.ex: He blinked and touched his eyelid.
words.ex_cn: 他眨了眨眼，摸了摸眼皮。
words.en: The eyelid is a thin fold of skin that covers and protects the eye.

words.ex: The concert was fabulous!
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会太棒了！
words.en: If you describe something as fabulous, you are emphasizing that you like it a lot or think that it is very good.

words.ex: The pottery on display is his handiwork.
words.ex_cn: 展出的陶器是他的手工品。
words.en: Work done by hand; manual work.

words.tr: n. <美><口>（精神或感情上的）烦恼; 焦虑; 困难; 问题
words.ex: He has a hang-up about his weight.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的体重有心理障碍。
words.en: A hang-up is a problem or difficulty that someone has, especially one that makes them behave in an unreasonable or irrational way.

words.ex: A hawk flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 一只鹰飞过田野。
words.en: A hawk is a bird of prey with a strong beak and sharp claws, known for its keen vision and swift flight. As a verb, to hawk means to sell goods aggressively, often in public places.

words.tr:
adj. 高层的（建筑）
n. 高楼；大厦；多层建筑物
words.ex: He lives in a high-rise building near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一栋高楼里。
words.en: A high-rise building is a tall building with many floors.

words.ex: A horde of children ran to the ice cream truck.
words.ex_cn: 一群孩子跑向冰淇淋车。
words.en: A horde is a large group of people or animals, especially one that is moving or acting together.

words.ex: The police seized illicit drugs from the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 警察从嫌疑人那里没收了非法毒品。
words.en: Illicit activities or substances are not allowed by law or by social or religious custom.

words.tr: adv. 无可挑剔地；无瑕疵地
words.ex: She dressed impeccably for the occasion.
words.ex_cn: 她为这个场合打扮得无可挑剔。
words.en: In a manner that is flawless or without fault.

words.ex: The nurse will inject medicine into his arm.
words.ex_cn: 护士将把药水注入他的手臂。
words.en: To inject a substance such as a medicine or drug means to put it into someone's body using a needle and a syringe.

words.ex: He filed a lawsuit against the company.
words.ex_cn: 他向这家公司提起了诉讼。
words.en: A lawsuit is a case in a court of law which concerns a dispute between two people or organizations.

words.tr: adj. 合法的；法律认可的；合理的；
words.ex: This contract is legitimate and signed by both parties.
words.ex_cn: 这份合同是合法的，并由双方签署。
words.en: Something that is legitimate is acceptable according to the law.

words.tr: adj. 被许可的； v. “license”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a licensed doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有执照的医生。
words.en: Officially permitted or authorized to do something.

words.ex: She underwent liposuction to remove excess fat from her abdomen.
words.ex_cn: 她接受了脂肪抽吸术以去除腹部多余的脂肪。
words.en: Liposuction is a surgical procedure in which fat is removed from a specific area of the body by suction.

words.ex: The clay is malleable and easy to shape.
words.ex_cn: 这种黏土是可塑的，容易塑形。
words.en: If you say that someone is malleable, you mean that they are easily influenced or controlled by other people.

words.tr:
v. 呻吟；呼啸；抱怨
n. 呻吟声；萧萧声；抱怨
words.ex: He moans when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 他累了的时候会呻吟。
words.en: If you moan, you make a low sound, usually because you are unhappy or in pain.

words.ex: The scientist studied a mutant frog with three legs.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究了一只有三条腿的突变青蛙。
words.en: A mutant is an organism or a new genetic character arising or resulting from an instance of mutation.

words.ex: The dog gave a small nip to his leg.
words.ex_cn: 狗轻轻咬了他的腿一口。
words.en: To nip means to pinch, squeeze, or bite something quickly and sharply. It can also refer to taking a small amount of a drink.

words.tr: adj. 非侵害的，非侵袭的
words.ex: The doctor recommended a noninvasive procedure to diagnose the condition.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议采用非侵入性程序来诊断病情。
words.en: Noninvasive refers to a medical procedure or treatment that does not require the body to be cut open or any instruments to be inserted into the body.

words.ex: She is a petite girl with big eyes.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个眼睛很大的娇小女孩。
words.en: If you describe a woman as petite, you are politely saying that she is small and slim.

words.ex: He gave her a light pinch on the arm.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻捏了她的胳膊一下。
words.en: To pinch someone or something means to squeeze them tightly between your thumb and finger, or between two surfaces, especially in a way that causes pain.

words.tr:
n. 塞子；
v. 插上；
words.ex: The sink is clogged because the plug is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 水槽堵塞了，因为塞子卡住了。
words.en: A plug is a small object at the end of a wire that is used for connecting a piece of electrical equipment to the main supply of electricity. It is also a piece of material that is used for blocking a hole.

words.tr:
adj. 丰满的；肥胖的
v. （使）圆胖；（使）鼓起
adv. 噗通地；直接地
words.ex: The baby has plump cheeks.
words.ex_cn: 这个婴儿有圆润的脸颊。
words.en: Having a full rounded shape; chubby.

words.tr: n. 冒牌者；妄求者；妄提要求者
words.ex: He is a pretender who fake his identity.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个冒充自己身份的冒牌者。
words.en: A pretender is someone who claims or aspires to a title or position, especially without justification.

words.tr:
n. 支撑物；支柱；道具
v. 支撑；靠
words.ex: He uses a prop to support the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个道具来支撑架子。
words.en: A prop is an object or piece of furniture that is used in a play or film to make a scene look more realistic, or something that is used to support or hold up another object.

words.tr: adj. 膨胀的；松软洁白的；白绒团状的
words.ex: The cat has puffy fur after the bath.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫洗完澡后毛茸茸的。
words.en: If part of your body is puffy, it is swollen because of an injury or because you are unwell.

words.ex: He burst into rage when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，他勃然大怒。
words.en: Rage is a feeling of intense anger that is difficult to control.

words.ex: He eats ramen for dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上吃拉面。
words.en: Ramen is a Japanese dish consisting of Chinese-style wheat noodles served in a meat or fish-based broth, often flavored with soy sauce or miso, and uses toppings such as sliced pork, dried seaweed, menma, and green onions.

words.tr: v. 再次申请；重新申请；再应用
words.ex: She decided to reapply for the same position after gaining more experience.
words.ex_cn: 她在获得更多经验后决定再次申请同一职位。
words.en: To apply again for something, especially a job, position, or course of study.

words.ex: The company is re-engineering its old system to work faster.
words.ex_cn: 公司正在重新设计旧系统以使其运行得更快。
words.en: The process of redesigning and restructuring a business process, organization, or product to improve its performance.

words.ex: The relentless rain flooded the streets.
words.ex_cn: 无情的雨水淹没了街道。
words.en: Someone who is relentless is determined to do something and refuses to give up, even if what they are doing is unpleasant or cruel.

words.tr:
v. 下垂；下跌；消沉
n. 下垂；下跌；下陷
words.ex: The old bridge sags in the middle.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧桥中间下垂。
words.en: If something sags, it hangs down loosely or sinks downwards in the middle, often because it is not supported properly or because it is too heavy.

words.ex: The mattress was old and saggy.
words.ex_cn: 这个床垫又旧又松垮。
words.en: Something that is saggy hangs or has sunk down in an unattractive way.

words.ex: The doctor uses a scalpel to cut the skin.
words.ex_cn: 医生用手术刀切开皮肤。
words.en: A scalpel is a small, extremely sharp knife used for surgery, anatomical dissection, and various arts and crafts.

words.tr: v. 沸腾；翻涌；骚动；激昂；大发雷霆
words.ex: The water began to seethe on the stove.
words.ex_cn: 水在炉子上开始沸腾。
words.en: If you say that someone is seething, you mean that they are very angry, but they are trying not to show it.

words.tr: v. 切断；脱离；切成两段
words.ex: He severed the rope with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀把绳子割断了。
words.en: To sever something means to cut through it or to break it off completely.

words.ex: The shady spot under the tree is cool.
words.ex_cn: 树下的背阴处很凉爽。
words.en: If you describe a person or activity as shady, you mean that they seem dishonest or illegal.

words.ex: Silicone is often used in medical implants.
words.ex_cn: 硅树脂常用于医疗植入物中。
words.en: Silicone is a synthetic material made from silicon, oxygen, and other elements, used in a wide range of products including sealants, adhesives, lubricants, and insulation materials.

words.tr: v. 杀死；杀害；残害；宰杀
words.ex: He slayed the monster in the dark forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在黑暗的森林里杀死了怪物。
words.en: To kill someone or something in a violent way.

words.tr: n. 中风；划水动作；一击；
words.ex: He had a stroke last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年中风了。
words.en: A stroke is a medical condition in which poor blood flow to the brain results in cell death. It can also refer to an act of hitting or striking someone or something, or a gentle movement of the hand over a surface.

words.tr: n. 发型师；文体家；造型设计师
words.ex: The stylist cut her hair beautifully.
words.ex_cn: 这位发型师把她的头发剪得非常漂亮。
words.en: A stylist is someone whose job is to create the style of something such as a piece of clothing, a piece of furniture, or a room.

words.ex: The baby suck milk from the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿从奶瓶里吮吸牛奶。
words.en: To draw something into the mouth by creating a partial vacuum with the lips and tongue; to be very bad or unpleasant.

words.ex: The surgeon fixed the broken bone.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生修复了断裂的骨头。
words.en: A surgeon is a medical doctor who performs operations.

words.tr: adj. 外科的；外科手术的；
words.ex: The surgical team worked quickly to save the patient.
words.ex_cn: 外科团队迅速工作以挽救病人。
words.en: Relating to or used in surgery.

words.tr:
n. 小孩；一小杯液体
v. 合计
words.ex: The tot was playing with his toys.
words.ex_cn: 那个小孩正在玩他的玩具。
words.en: A tot can refer to a very young child or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to add up numbers or amounts to reach a total.

words.tr:
v. 把…塞进狭窄的空间；把…藏入
n. 褶皱；零食
words.ex: He tucked the letter into his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他把信塞进了口袋里。
words.en: If you tuck something somewhere, you put it there so that it is safe, comfortable, or neat.

words.ex: This rule is universal for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则对所有学生都是普遍适用的。
words.en: Something that is universal affects or relates to every part of the world or the universe.

words.ex: The operation of unlicensed vehicles is strictly prohibited.
words.ex_cn: 无牌照车辆的运营被严格禁止。
words.en: If something is unlicensed, it is operating or being used without official permission.

words.tr:
v. 提升；提高；改进；
n. 增加；改进；
words.ex: He upgraded his phone to get better performance.
words.ex_cn: 他升级了手机以获得更好的性能。
words.en: To upgrade means to improve the quality or usefulness of something, or to raise it to a higher standard. It can also refer to the process of improving or raising something.

words.tr:
adj. 高档的；高级的
adv. 高档地；高级地
words.ex: This shop sells up-market clothes.
words.ex_cn: 这家店出售高档服装。
words.en: Up-market refers to goods, services, or areas that are designed to appeal to or are used by people who have a lot of money and like to spend it on expensive, high-quality things.

words.tr: adj. 紧张不安的； 心情焦躁的；易怒的
words.ex: He gets uptight when people are late.
words.ex_cn: 当别人迟到时，他会变得紧张。
words.en: If you say that someone is uptight, you mean that they are very tense, nervous, or angry about something.

words.ex: He bought a new mirror because of his vanity.
words.ex_cn: 他因为虚荣心买了一面新镜子。
words.en: The quality of being vain; excessive pride in or admiration of one's own appearance or achievements.

words.ex: The wall-mounted TV provides a clear view from any angle.
words.ex_cn: 壁挂式电视从任何角度都能提供清晰的视野。
words.en: Designed to be attached to a wall.

words.ex: He wields his knowledge to solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他运用自己的知识来解决问题。
words.en: To wield something means to hold and use it, especially as a weapon or tool. It can also mean to have and be able to use power or influence.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 任何普通人；任何一个无名之辈
words.ex: I don't want any Tom, Dick, or Harry walking into my house.
words.ex_cn: 我不希望随便哪个人都能走进我的房子。
words.en: Any ordinary or average person, without any specific qualifications or distinctions.

words.tr: phrase. 非常成功；大受欢迎；引起轰动
words.ex: The new movie is expected to be a hit at the box office.
words.ex_cn: v. 预计这部新电影在票房上会大受欢迎。
words.en: To be very successful or popular, especially in entertainment or sales.

words.w: beauty is in the eye of the beholder
words.tr: 谚语. 情人眼里出西施；美在于观赏者的眼光
words.uk: ˈbjuːti ɪz ɪn ði ˈaɪ əv ðə bɪˈhəʊldə(r)
words.us: ˈbjuːti ɪz ɪn ði ˈaɪ əv ðə bɪˈhoʊldər
words.ex: Some people think modern art is beautiful, while others don't understand it at all. It just goes to show that beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
words.ex_cn: 有些人认为现代艺术很美，而其他人则完全不懂它。这正好说明美是主观的，美在于观者之眼。
words.en: The phrase 'beauty is in the eye of the beholder' means that the perception of beauty is subjective and varies from person to person.

words.ex: He decided to buy into the new company.
words.ex_cn: 他决定买进这家新公司。
words.en: To accept or believe in an idea, argument, or philosophy.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 切碎；剁碎；砍碎
words.ex: He will chop up the vegetables for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他会把蔬菜切碎准备晚餐。
words.en: To cut something into small pieces.

words.ex: He prefers to pay in hard cash rather than using credit cards.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢用现金支付，而不是使用信用卡。
words.en: Hard cash refers to physical money in the form of coins or banknotes, as opposed to credit or electronic forms of payment.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；抑制；使退缩；隐瞒
words.ex: He tried to hold back his tears.
words.ex_cn: 他试图忍住眼泪。
words.en: To hold back means to prevent someone or something from moving forward or making progress, or to keep something secret or not express your feelings.

words.tr: phrase. 在追求……的过程中；为了寻求……
words.ex: Scientists are in the quest for a cure for cancer.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们正在寻求癌症的治疗方法。
words.en: In the process of seeking or searching for something.

words.w: judge a book by its cover
words.tr: phrase. 以貌取人；凭外表判断（事物好坏）
words.ex: You shouldn't judge a book by its cover; you might miss out on a great story.
words.ex_cn: 你不应该以貌取人；你可能会错过一个精彩的故事。
words.en: To form an opinion about someone or something based on appearance without knowing the facts.

words.ex: Tom often lags behind in class because he doesn't study.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆因为不学习，经常在课堂上落后。
words.en: To fail to keep up with others or to fall behind in progress, development, or achievement.

words.tr: phrase. 轻易赚取；迅速取得
words.ex: They rake in a lot of money from their small shop.
words.ex_cn: 他们从自己的小店里赚了很多钱。
