words.en: To earn a lot of money, especially quickly or easily.

words.tr: phrase. 使……遭受；使……服从；使……受制于
words.ex: They subject the material to high temperatures.
words.ex_cn: 他们将材料置于高温下。
words.en: To cause someone or something to experience something, especially something unpleasant.

words.tr: phrase. 最高价；最高报酬；最昂贵的价格
words.ex: She was willing to pay top dollar for the rare antique.
words.ex_cn: 她愿意为这件稀有的古董支付最高价钱。
words.en: A very high price or amount of money paid for something.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Text B New Words

words.tr:
adj. 造成极度痛苦的；令人焦虑不安的
v. 感到极度焦虑；折磨；苦苦思索；“agonize”的现在分词
words.ex: He felt agonizing pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到极度痛苦。
words.en: causing great physical or mental pain

words.ex: He screamed in agony after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒后痛苦地大叫。
words.en: Agony is very severe physical or mental pain.

words.ex: The old man walks with a cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人拄着藤杖走路。
words.en: A cane is a long, thin stick that you can use to help you walk, or it is a stick used for punishing people by hitting them. It is also a tall, hard plant like bamboo, from which sugar is made.

words.ex: The cartilage in his knee hurts when he runs.
words.ex_cn: 他的膝盖软骨在跑步时会疼。
words.en: Cartilage is a strong, flexible connective tissue found in various parts of the body, including the joints, the rib cage, the ear, the nose, the bronchial tubes, and the intervertebral discs. It is not as hard and rigid as bone, but it is stiffer and less flexible than muscle.

words.tr: n. （学校、医院、军队、监狱中的）牧师；
words.ex: The chaplain prayed with the soldiers before the mission.
words.ex_cn: 牧师在任务前为士兵们祈祷。
words.en: A chaplain is a member of the clergy attached to a private chapel, institution, ship, regiment, etc.

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.ex: He visits a chiropractor for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他去看整骨医生治疗背痛。
words.en: A chiropractor is a person who treats diseases by manipulating the spine and other parts of the body.

words.ex: The circulation of blood keeps us alive.
words.ex_cn: 血液的循环让我们活着。
words.en: The movement of something such as money or goods from place to place or from person to person; the number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are sold.

words.ex: Collagen is a protein that provides structure to skin and connective tissues.
words.ex_cn: 胶原蛋白是一种为皮肤和结缔组织提供结构的蛋白质。
words.en: Collagen is a fibrous protein that is the main constituent of connective tissue in animals and the most abundant protein in mammals, making up about 25% to 35% of the whole-body protein content.

words.ex: He is a conservative man who likes old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢古老传统的保守男子。
words.en: A conservative person or group is one that does not like changes or new ideas, especially in politics or religion.

words.tr: v. 委托；交付；托运；寄售
words.ex: He will consign the package to the post office.
words.ex_cn: 他将把包裹寄到邮局。
words.en: If you consign something to someone, you give it to them to keep or to sell.

words.ex: The shoes have good cushioning for running.
words.ex_cn: 这双鞋有很好的减震效果，适合跑步。
words.en: Cushioning refers to the material or substance that reduces the effect of impact or pressure, providing comfort or protection.

words.tr: v. 使衰弱；使虚弱；“debilitate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The illness was debilitating her strength.
words.ex_cn: 这场疾病正在使她的体力衰弱。
words.en: If you say that a disease or condition is debilitating, you mean that it makes people physically or mentally weak.

words.tr: n. 衰落；退化；恶化；变质
words.ex: The degeneration of the old building worried the town.
words.ex_cn: 这座老建筑的衰落让小镇居民感到担忧。
words.en: The process by which something declines or deteriorates, often in terms of quality, function, or moral standards.

words.ex: Alzheimer's is a degenerative disease.
words.ex_cn: 阿尔茨海默病是一种衰退性疾病。
words.en: A degenerative disease or condition is one that gradually gets worse.

words.tr:
n. 安逸；轻松；
v. 缓解；减轻；
words.ex: He enjoys the ease of living in a quiet village.
words.ex_cn: 他享受住在安静村庄里的安逸。
words.en: If you talk about the ease of a particular activity, you are referring to the way that it has been made easier to do, or to the fact that it is already easy to do. Ease is also a state of being comfortable and without worry or anxiety.

words.ex: The rubber band shows great elasticity when stretched.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋被拉伸时表现出很大的弹性。
words.en: The ability of an object or material to resume its normal shape after being stretched or compressed.

words.tr: adj. 难以捉摸的；不易被抓获（觉察、理解或记忆）的；
words.ex: The truth remained elusive.
words.ex_cn: 真相难以捉摸。
words.en: Difficult to find, catch, or achieve; difficult to remember or understand.

words.ex: He envisions a world without war.
words.ex_cn: 他想象一个没有战争的世界。
words.en: To envision something is to imagine it as a future possibility; it is often used to describe the act of foreseeing or planning for the future.

words.tr: adj. 硬（脑）膜上的，硬脑膜外的 n. [医学] =epidural anesthesia
words.ex: She received an epidural before giving birth.
words.ex_cn: 她在分娩前接受了硬膜外麻醉。
words.en: An epidural is a type of anesthesia that is injected into the space around the spinal cord to block pain signals from the lower body during surgery or childbirth.

words.ex: She applied hair gel to style her hair.
words.ex_cn: 她用了发胶来造型头发。
words.en: A gel is a thick, jelly-like substance, especially one used to style hair.

words.tr: n. （教会办的）旅客招待所；临终关怀医院；临终安养院
words.ex: He spent his last days in a hospice.
words.ex_cn: 他最后的日子是在临终关怀机构度过的。
words.en: A hospice is a special hospital or home for people who are dying, where they are cared for by specially trained nurses and doctors.

words.tr: adj. 可植入的，可移植的
words.ex: The company developed an implantable device for heart monitoring.
words.ex_cn: 该公司开发了一种用于心脏监测的可植入设备。
words.en: Capable of being implanted, especially in the body for therapeutic or diagnostic purposes.

words.ex: The implantation of the heart took place successfully.
words.ex_cn: 心脏的移植成功进行了。
words.en: The process of inserting or grafting something, especially a fertilized egg, into a living organism.

words.tr:
adj. 红外线的
n. 红外线
words.ex: The remote uses infrared to change the TV channel.
words.ex_cn: 遥控器使用红外线来切换电视频道。
words.en: Infrared refers to the region of the electromagnetic spectrum with wavelengths longer than visible light but shorter than microwaves, often used in technology for night vision and heat sensing.

words.ex: The intervertebral disc acts as a cushion between the vertebrae.
words.ex_cn: 椎间盘在椎骨之间起到缓冲作用。
words.en: Located or occurring between vertebrae.

words.ex: The invasive plant spreads quickly and kills other plants.
words.ex_cn: 这种侵入性植物生长迅速，会杀死其他植物。
words.en: If you describe something as invasive, you mean that it spreads very quickly and is difficult to stop.

words.ex: He hurt his ligament while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时拉伤了韧带。
words.en: A ligament is a band of strong tissue in a person's body which connects bones.

words.ex: He has pain in his lumbar area.
words.ex_cn: 他的腰部有疼痛。
words.en: Relating to the lower part of the back.

words.ex: He gave his mother a massage after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后给妈妈做了按摩。
words.en: The act of rubbing and pressing someone's body with the hands to reduce tension or pain in the muscles.

words.ex: Methadone is commonly used in the treatment of opioid addiction.
words.ex_cn: 美沙酮常用于治疗阿片类药物成瘾。
words.en: Methadone is a synthetic opioid used as an analgesic and as maintenance therapy in people with opioid dependence.

words.ex: He minimally helped with the project.
words.ex_cn: 他只是最低限度地帮忙了这个项目。
words.en: To a minimal degree or extent; as little as possible.

words.tr: adj. 奇迹般的；不可思议的；神奇的
words.ex: The sick boy made a miraculous recovery.
words.ex_cn: 那个生病的男孩奇迹般地康复了。
words.en: If you describe a good event as miraculous, you mean that it is very surprising and unexpected.

words.tr: v. 迷惑；使迷惑不解；使糊涂
words.ex: The magic trick will mystify the children.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术会让孩子们感到困惑。
words.en: If you are mystified by something, you find it impossible to explain or understand.

words.ex: The neurostimulator was implanted to help manage chronic pain.
words.ex_cn: 神经刺激器被植入体内以帮助控制慢性疼痛。
words.en: A neurostimulator is a medical device that delivers electrical impulses to the nerves to manage chronic pain or other neurological conditions.

words.ex: The neurosurgeon successfully removed the tumor from the patient's brain.
words.ex_cn: 神经外科医生成功地从病人脑中切除了肿瘤。
words.en: A neurosurgeon is a medical specialist who performs surgical operations on the brain and other parts of the nervous system.

words.ex: He went on an odyssey to find his lost brother.
words.ex_cn: 他踏上了一段寻找失散兄弟的漫长旅程。
words.en: An odyssey is a long and eventful or adventurous journey or experience.

words.ex: This tradition originates from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: To originate means to have a specific beginning or to start something.

words.tr: n. 领跑者；带头人；标兵；心脏起搏器
words.ex: The athlete was the pacemaker for the entire race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员是整场比赛的领跑者。
words.en: A pacemaker is a small device that's placed in the chest or abdomen to help control abnormal heart rhythms. This device uses electrical pulses to prompt the heart to beat at a normal rate.

words.ex: He took a painkiller for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一片止痛药来缓解头痛。
words.en: A painkiller is a drug that reduces or removes physical pain.

words.tr:
n. 轻拍；
v. 轻拍；
words.ex: He gave the dog a gentle pat on the head.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻拍了拍狗的头。
words.en: To gently touch someone or something with your hand flat.

words.ex: He goes to physiotherapy after his surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他手术后去做物理治疗。
words.en: Physiotherapy is the treatment of disease, injury, or deformity by physical methods such as massage, heat treatment, and exercise rather than by drugs or surgery.

words.ex: The prolonged rain caused flooding.
words.ex_cn: 持久的降雨引发了洪水。
words.en: Something that is prolonged continues for a long time, or longer than expected.

words.tr: adj. 有希望的；有前途的； v. 承诺；答应；“promise”的现在分词；
words.ex: The young boy is a promising student.
words.ex_cn: 这个小男孩是个有希望的学生。
words.en: Showing signs of future success or achievement.

words.ex: Lizards can regenerate their tails.
words.ex_cn: 蜥蜴可以再生尾巴。
words.en: To regenerate means to grow or form again, especially after being damaged or lost, or to improve a place or system by making it more active or successful.

words.ex: This plant has regenerative powers.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物具有再生能力。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by regeneration; able to regrow or be renewed.

words.ex: He hurt his spinal cord in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中伤到了脊髓。
words.en: Relating to the spine or the spinal cord.

words.ex: The boy hurt his spine when he fell from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 他从树上摔下来时伤到了脊柱。
words.en: The spine is the row of bones down the center of your back that supports your body and protects your spinal cord.

words.ex: The doctor diagnosed a stenosis in the artery.
words.ex_cn: 医生诊断出动脉狭窄。
words.en: A stenosis is an abnormal narrowing in a blood vessel or other tubular organ or structure.

words.tr: n. 患病者；受苦者；受难者
words.ex: The sufferer felt better after resting.
words.ex_cn: 这位患者休息后感觉好多了。
words.en: A sufferer is someone who is experiencing pain, illness, or distress.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.ex: The vertebra supports the spine.
words.ex_cn: 椎骨支撑着脊柱。
words.en: A vertebra is one of the small bones that form the spine.

words.ex: Children are vulnerable to colds in winter.
words.ex_cn: 儿童在冬天容易感冒。
words.en: If someone or something is vulnerable, they are weak and without protection, with the result that they are easily hurt physically or emotionally.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He uses a calculator in conjunction with paper.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算器和纸一起计算。
words.en: Together with; in combination or coordination with.

words.ex: This tradition originates from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: To come from a particular place or start in a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 放心；确信无疑；尽管放心
words.ex: Rest assured, I will help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 放心吧，我会帮你做作业。
words.en: If you say that someone can rest assured that something is the case, you mean that it is definitely the case, so they do not need to worry about it.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Text A New Words

words.tr: adj. 贫血的；患贫血症的；衰弱无力的；无生气的
words.ex: He looks anemic after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 他生病很久后看起来很苍白。
words.en: If someone is anemic, they are suffering from anemia, which means they have a lower than normal number of red blood cells or hemoglobin, making them feel tired and weak.

words.tr: adv. 每年地；一年一次地；
words.ex: He visits his parents annually.
words.ex_cn: 他每年去看望他的父母。
words.en: Happening once every year.

words.ex: I assure you that everything will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 我向你保证一切都会好起来的。
words.en: If you assure someone that something is true or will happen, you tell them that it is definitely true or will definitely happen, often in order to make them less worried.

words.tr:
v. 禁止；
n. 禁止；
words.ex: The school bans phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If there is a ban on something, it is not allowed. If something is banned, it is not allowed to be done, shown, or used.

words.ex: He basically just wants to be left alone.
words.ex_cn: 他基本上只是想一个人待着。
words.en: You use basically to indicate that you are stating a fact or opinion in a simple, clear, or definite way.

words.tr: phrase. 最讨厌的人或物；棘手的问题
words.ex: Mosquitoes are his bête noire during summer.
words.ex_cn: 蚊子是他夏天最讨厌的东西。
words.en: A person or thing that one particularly dislikes or dreads.

words.ex: He lives in a quiet borough of New York.
words.ex_cn: 他住在纽约的一个安静的行政区。
words.en: A borough is a town, or a district within a large city, that has its own local government.

words.tr: adj. 按时间先后顺序排列的
words.ex: The events are listed in chronological order.
words.ex_cn: 这些事件按时间顺序列出。
words.en: If things are described or shown in chronological order, they are described or shown in the order in which they happened.

words.tr: n. 抓斗; 蛤壳; 蚌壳; 蛤壳式物品
words.ex: The clamshell design allows for easy opening and closing.
words.ex_cn: 蛤壳式设计使得开合变得容易。
words.en: A clamshell is the shell of a clam or a similar type of shellfish, or something that resembles such a shell in shape or design.

words.ex: His collection of old coins is very rare.
words.ex_cn: 他收集的旧硬币非常稀有。
words.en: A collection is a group of things, often of the same type, that have been gathered together over a period of time.

words.ex: He spoke colloquially, using many slang terms.
words.ex_cn: 他用通俗的语言说话，使用了很多俚语。
words.en: In a way that is used in ordinary or familiar conversation; not formal or literary.

words.ex: The commissioner ordered the police to stop the protest.
words.ex_cn: 长官命令警察制止抗议活动。
words.en: A commissioner is an official in charge of a government department or a public organization, especially in the UK.

words.ex: The company showed compliance with safety rules.
words.ex_cn: 该公司遵守了安全规定。
words.en: The act of complying with a wish, request, or demand; obedience.

words.ex: He uses compost to make his garden soil richer.
words.ex_cn: 他用堆肥来使花园的土壤更肥沃。
words.en: Compost is a mixture of decaying organic matter, such as leaves and food scraps, used to improve soil structure and provide nutrients for plants.

words.ex: We should conserve water in daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们应在日常生活中节约用水。
words.en: To conserve something means to protect it from harm, loss, or change, especially in order to preserve it for the future.

words.tr: adj. 有成本效益的；划算的
words.ex: This bike is cost-effective and saves money.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车物有所值，能省钱。
words.en: Something that is cost-effective gives the best possible profit or benefits in comparison with the money that is spent.

words.ex: He covets his neighbor's car.
words.ex_cn: 他垂涎邻居的车。
words.en: If you covet something, you have a very strong desire to possess it, especially something that belongs to someone else.

words.tr: adv. 关键性地；至关重要地；
words.ex: It is crucially important to study every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天学习关键性地重要。
words.en: In a way that is extremely important or essential.

words.ex: The old wall began to crumble after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 旧墙在雨后开始坍塌。
words.en: If something crumbles, or if you crumble it, it breaks into a lot of small pieces.

words.ex: The deputy signed the document for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 代理人替经理签署了文件。
words.en: A deputy is a person who is appointed to act as a substitute for another, especially in a position of authority.

words.ex: Sugar dissolves in water.
words.ex_cn: 糖在水中溶解。
words.en: If a substance dissolves in liquid or if you dissolve a substance, it becomes mixed with the liquid and disappears.

words.ex: This park is an ecological habitat for many birds.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是许多鸟类的生态栖息地。
words.en: Relating to or concerned with the relation of living organisms to one another and to their physical surroundings.

words.tr: v. 制定（法律）；通过（法律）；扮演（角色）
words.ex: The government will enact a new law next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将颁布一项新法律。
words.en: To enact a law or rule means to make it official by passing it through a legislative body.

words.ex: He ate excessive amounts of candy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了过多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe the amount or level of something as excessive, you disapprove of it because it is more or higher than is necessary or reasonable.

words.ex: He eats fiber to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃纤维来保持健康。
words.en: A fiber is a thread or a structure or object resembling a thread, especially one that is used to make cloth or rope.

words.ex: The fluorescent lamp lights up the room quickly.
words.ex_cn: 荧光灯很快照亮了房间。
words.en: Fluorescent substances produce bright light of a particular color when they are exposed to light of a different wavelength.

words.ex: The framework of the house is made of wood.
words.ex_cn: 房子的骨架是木制的。
words.en: A framework is a particular set of rules, ideas, or beliefs which you use in order to deal with problems or to decide what to do.

words.tr: adj. 失意的；挫败的； v. “frustrate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt frustrated when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 当他考试不及格时，他感到失意。
words.en: If you are frustrated, you are upset or angry because you are unable to do anything about a situation.

words.tr: adj. 真菌的；真菌引起的；
words.ex: The fungal infection spread quickly on the skin.
words.ex_cn: 真菌感染在皮肤上迅速扩散。
words.en: relating to, caused by, or resembling a fungus or fungi.

words.tr: adj. 灰色的，头发斑白的 v. （尤指儿童）哭着不停地抱怨（某事）( grizzle的过去式和过
words.ex: The old man had a grizzled beard.
words.ex_cn: 那位老人有一把斑白的胡子。
words.en: Having hair that is grey or partly grey.

words.tr:
n. （赞美上帝用语）哈利路亚 
int. 哈利路亚（表示赞美或欢乐）
words.ex: The choir sang a beautiful hallelujah chorus.
words.ex_cn: 唱诗班唱了一首优美的哈利路亚合唱曲。
words.en: An exclamation of praise, joy, or thanks to God.

words.ex: The coat is on a hanger in the closet.
words.ex_cn: 外套挂在衣橱里的衣架上。
words.en: A hanger is a curved piece of wood, metal, or plastic that you use to hang clothes on.

words.ex: The chemicals are hazardous to health.
words.ex_cn: 这些化学物质对健康有危险。
words.en: Something that is hazardous is dangerous, especially to people's health or safety.

words.ex: The city has recently installed a new incinerator to dispose of waste.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市最近安装了一台新的焚化炉来处理废物。
words.en: An incinerator is a large machine designed to burn waste materials at high temperatures, reducing them to ash and other residues.

words.ex: The mushrooms are inedible and dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这些蘑菇不能吃，而且危险。
words.en: If something is inedible, it is not suitable for eating because it is unpleasant or harmful.

words.tr: n. 肥皂泡; 紧张; 激动; （马的）汗沫 vi. （指肥皂）形成泡沫 vt. 用皂沫覆盖; <口
words.ex: The horse was covered in lather after the race.
words.ex_cn: 比赛后，马全身都是汗沫。
words.en: Lather is a frothy white mass of bubbles produced by soap or a similar substance when mixed with water.

words.tr: v. 制定法律；用立法规定
words.ex: The government will legislate new rules next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将制定新规则。
words.en: To legislate means to make or enact laws.

words.ex: The new legislation bans plastic bags.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法规禁止使用塑料袋。
words.en: Legislation refers to the process of making or enacting laws by a government or other authority.

words.tr:
n. 织布机；
v. 迫近；
words.ex: The old loom made a loud clicking sound.
words.ex_cn: 那台旧织布机发出很大的咔嗒声。
words.en: If something looms over you, it appears as a large or unclear shape, often in a way that is frightening or causes worry.

words.ex: He bought a new mattress for his bed.
words.ex_cn: 他为床买了一个新床垫。
words.en: A mattress is a large, flat pad that is placed on a bed to make it comfortable to sleep on.

words.ex: His mindset helps him stay positive during hard times.
words.ex_cn: 他的心态让他在困难时期保持积极。
words.en: A mindset is a set of attitudes or fixed ideas that someone has and that are often difficult to change.

words.tr:
adj. 净余的；
n. 网；
words.ex: The net profit after taxes is $500.
words.ex_cn: 缴税后的净收益是500美元。
words.en: A net is a piece of thin fabric or thread that is used to catch fish, insects, or other small animals. It can also refer to the amount of money remaining after all expenses have been deducted.

words.tr: adj. 不可再生的; 不可更新的
words.ex: Coal is a nonrenewable resource.
words.ex_cn: 煤是一种不可再生资源。
words.en: Nonrenewable resources are natural resources that cannot be replenished or would take a very long time to replenish naturally.

words.ex: This product is made from nontoxic materials.
words.ex_cn: 这个产品是由无毒材料制成的。
words.en: Not containing or being poisonous material.

words.ex: This experiment is a paradigm of scientific method.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验是科学方法的范例。
words.en: A paradigm is a model or pattern that is considered to be a typical example of something.

words.ex: His answer was pertinent to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答与问题相关。
words.en: Something that is pertinent is relevant to a particular subject.

words.ex: The bottle is made of polyethylene.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是聚乙烯做的。
words.en: Polyethylene is a lightweight thermoplastic used in a wide variety of applications, including packaging, containers, and insulation.

words.ex: The cup is made of polystyrene.
words.ex_cn: 这个杯子是用聚苯乙烯制成的。
words.en: Polystyrene is a synthetic aromatic hydrocarbon polymer made from the monomer styrene. Polystyrene can be solid or foamed. General-purpose polystyrene is clear, hard, and brittle. It is a very inexpensive resin per unit weight.

words.tr: adj. 可回收利用的；可再循环的；
words.ex: This bottle is recyclable.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是可回收利用的。
words.en: Capable of being recycled; able to be processed and used again.

words.tr: prep. 关于； v. 看待；“regard”的现在分词；
words.ex: He sent me an email regarding the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他给我发了一封关于会议的邮件。
words.en: You can use regarding to indicate the subject that is being talked or written about.

words.ex: The resale of used books is popular online.
words.ex_cn: 二手书的转售在网上很流行。
words.en: The sale of something previously bought, typically at a higher price than the original purchase.

words.tr: adj. 刻板的；坚硬的；严格的；
words.ex: He has a rigid attitude toward rules.
words.ex_cn: 他对规则的态度很刻板。
words.en: not able to be changed or adapted; not able to be bent or moved; stiff

words.tr: n. 公共卫生；卫生设施；
words.ex: The city improved sanitation to keep people healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了公共卫生以保障人民健康。
words.en: The conditions and processes that help maintain health and prevent disease, especially through cleanliness.

words.tr: adj. 感染病菌的；脓毒性的；败血的；腐败性的
words.ex: The wound became septic after several days.
words.ex_cn: 伤口几天后变得脓毒性。
words.en: relating to or denoting sepsis, especially septicemia.

words.ex: The simplicity of the design makes it easy to use.
words.ex_cn: 这种设计的简单使它容易使用。
words.en: The quality or condition of being easy to understand or do.

words.ex: Plastic straws are often single-use items.
words.ex_cn: 塑料吸管通常是使用一次的物品。
words.en: Designed to be used once and then thrown away.

words.tr: n. 鬼怪；幽灵；缠绕心头的恐惧
words.ex: The specter of famine haunted the war-torn region.
words.ex_cn: 饥荒的幽灵在饱受战争蹂躏的地区徘徊。
words.en: A specter is a ghost or a phantom, or something that haunts or perturbs the mind.

words.ex: The honey is sticky.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是黏的。
words.en: Something that is sticky is covered with a substance that things stick to.

words.ex: The packaging was made of Styrofoam.
words.ex_cn: 包装是由泡沫聚苯乙烯制成的。
words.en: A light, resilient polystyrene foam used especially for making food containers and insulation materials.

words.tr: n. <美>外卖餐馆，外卖食品; （桥牌中）示意搭档改叫的叫牌 adj. 外卖的，供顾客带出外吃的
words.ex: I ordered pizza takeout for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我订了外卖披萨当晚餐。
words.en: Takeout refers to food that is prepared in a restaurant and is intended to be eaten elsewhere.

words.ex: The taxpayer paid his taxes on time.
words.ex_cn: 纳税人按时缴税了。
words.en: A taxpayer is a person or organization that pays taxes to the government.

words.tr: adj. （纸片等）可撕下的，可沿齿孔（或虚线）撕下的
words.ex: The menu had a tear-off section for customer comments.
words.ex_cn: 菜单上有一部分是供顾客评论的可撕下部分。
words.en: Designed to be easily removed by tearing, especially along a perforated line.

words.ex: Polyethylene terephthalate is widely used in the production of plastic bottles.
words.ex_cn: 聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯广泛用于塑料瓶的生产。
words.en: A salt or ester of terephthalic acid, used especially in the manufacture of polyester fibers and resins.

words.ex: He checked the thermometer to see the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 他看了温度计来查看温度。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.

words.tr: n. （使用后抛弃的）广告传单，散单，宣传小册子
words.ex: He picked up a throwaway from the street corner.
words.ex_cn: 他在街角捡了一张广告传单。
words.en: Something that is designed to be used once or for a short time and then thrown away.

words.ex: The tip of the pencil broke off.
words.ex_cn: 铅笔的尖端断了。
words.en: The end of a pointed or projecting object; a sum of money given to someone as a reward for their services; to give someone a small amount of money as a reward for their services.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.tr: n. 垃圾；无价值的东西；
words.ex: The trash bin is full.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾桶满了。
words.en: Waste material or unwanted things that are thrown away.

words.tr: n. 货车荷载；一卡车（的量）；大量
words.ex: He bought a truckload of apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一卡车的苹果。
words.en: A truckload is the amount that a truck can carry.

words.tr:
adv. 州的北部地区的；；（美国的一州内）远离大城市的
adj. 在州的北部地区；（美国的一州内）远离大城市的地
n. 州内远离大城市的地区；州的北部
words.ex: He lives in upstate New York.
words.ex_cn: 他住在纽约州北部。
words.en: Upstate refers to the northern part of a state, especially in the context of New York State.

words.ex: The detergent is water-soluble, making it easy to clean up.
words.ex_cn: 这种清洁剂可溶于水，便于清理。
words.en: Capable of dissolving in water.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: 短语. 对……有益的事物；对……有帮助的东西
words.ex: The new technology has been a boon to productivity.
words.ex_cn: 这项新技术对生产力来说是一大福音。
words.en: Something that is very helpful and improves the quality of life.

words.tr: phrase. （用于数量之后）至少，最少
words.ex: At the very least, you should apologize for your behavior.
words.ex_cn: 至少，你应该为你的行为道歉。
words.en: used to indicate the minimum that is expected or required

words.tr: phrase. 对...感到厌烦；受够了...
words.ex: He is fed up with doing the same work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天做同样的工作。
words.en: To be bored, annoyed, or unhappy, especially with a situation that has existed for a long time.

words.ex: It's difficult to conceive of a world without music.
words.ex_cn: 很难想象一个没有音乐的世界。
words.en: To form a mental representation or idea of something.

words.tr: phrase. 折叠成；把…折入；迅速包围或吞并
words.ex: He fold into the blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他把毯子叠起来。
words.en: To mix a lighter substance into a heavier one by turning it over gently with a spoon or spatula.

words.tr: phrase. 大体上；基本上；在大多数情况下
words.ex: For the most part, he walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 大多数时候，他走路去学校。
words.en: You use for the most part to indicate that something is generally true or mostly happens in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 独自行动；单干；不依赖他人
words.ex: He decided to go it alone and start his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他决定独自一人创业。
words.en: To do something without help from anyone else.

words.tr: phrase. 正在与……讨论；与……进行磋商
words.ex: The company is in discussions with several potential investors.
words.ex_cn: 该公司正在与几位潜在投资者进行讨论。
words.en: Engaged in conversation or negotiation with someone or a group about a particular subject or project.

words.ex: In the event that it rains, we will stay home.
words.ex_cn: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里。
words.en: If something happens; in case something happens.

words.tr: phrase. 摆脱困境；脱身；免除责任；电话听筒未挂好
words.ex: He managed to get off the hook by blaming someone else.
words.ex_cn: 他通过责怪别人成功摆脱了困境。
words.en: If someone is off the hook, they have managed to get out of the difficult situation they were in.

words.tr: phrase. 突然开口说话；插话；高声说话
words.ex: The little boy finally piped up when the teacher asked a question.
words.ex_cn: 当老师提问时，小男孩终于开口了。
words.en: To start speaking, especially to interrupt or to say something suddenly.

words.ex: The company decided to scale up its production capacity.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定按比例提高其生产能力。
words.en: To increase the size, amount, or importance of something, especially a business or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 揭露；阐明；使…清晰可见
words.ex: An investigation might shine a light on the corruption within the organization.
words.ex_cn: 一项调查可能会揭示该组织内部的腐败现象。
words.en: To make something clear or understandable by providing information or explanation.

words.ex: He will step down from the stage after the speech.
words.ex_cn: 演讲结束后，他会走下舞台。
words.en: To resign from a position or to reduce the intensity, amount, or level of something.

words.tr: phrase. 增加；提升；加紧；走上前
words.ex: He will step up to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他将挺身而出帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To increase the amount, speed, or intensity of something.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Text B New Words

words.ex: The adaptation of animals to cold weather is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 动物对寒冷天气的适应令人惊叹。
words.en: An adaptation is a film, television drama, or stage play that is based on a written work.

words.ex: He likes math, and additionally, he enjoys science.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，此外，他还喜欢科学。
words.en: You use additionally to introduce extra information or to emphasize a point.

words.ex: The algal bloom in the lake caused a noticeable discoloration.
words.ex_cn: 湖中的藻类大量繁殖导致湖水明显变色。
words.en: Relating to or resembling algae.

words.ex: The arid land has little rain and no trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片干旱的土地降雨稀少，没有树木。
words.en: An arid area of land has so little rain that it is very dry and cannot support much vegetation.

words.ex: The bacterium causes sickness in humans.
words.ex_cn: 这种细菌会导致人类生病。
words.en: A bacterium is a very small organism which often causes disease.

words.ex: The coastal village has beautiful beaches.
words.ex_cn: 这个沿海村庄有美丽的海滩。
words.en: relating to the coast, the area where the land meets the sea

words.ex: The conflict between the two countries lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家之间的冲突持续了多年。
words.en: A conflict is a serious disagreement or argument, typically a protracted one.

words.ex: Dengue fever is a mosquito-borne viral infection.
words.ex_cn: 登革热是一种由蚊子传播的病毒感染。
words.en: Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral infection causing a severe flu-like illness and, sometimes causing a potentially lethal complication called severe dengue.

words.tr: v. 取代；迫使…离开家园；
words.ex: The new robot will displace the workers on the assembly line.
words.ex_cn: 这个新机器人将取代装配线上的工人。
words.en: To displace something or someone means to take their place or to force them to leave their usual place or role.

words.ex: The storm disrupted the train service.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴中断了火车服务。
words.en: To disrupt a system, process, or event means to prevent it from continuing or operating in a normal way.

words.tr: n. 港湾；河口湾；河口；入海口；
words.ex: The river flows into the estuary before reaching the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流在入海前流入港湾。
words.en: An estuary is the wide part of a river where it nears the sea; fresh and salt water mix.

words.ex: The festival celebrates ethnic music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日庆祝民族音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Ethnic relates to a group of people who have a common national or cultural tradition.

words.ex: Smoking can exacerbate asthma.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会使哮喘加重。
words.en: If something exacerbates a problem or bad situation, it makes it worse.

words.ex: The extraction of coal harms the environment.
words.ex_cn: 煤炭的开采对环境有害。
words.en: The process of removing or obtaining something from something else.

words.ex: The fishery near the coast provides fresh seafood.
words.ex_cn: 沿海的渔场提供新鲜海产。
words.en: A fishery is an area where fish are caught for commercial purposes, or the industry of catching and selling fish.

words.ex: The old man is frail and needs help to walk.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人瘦弱，需要帮助才能走路。
words.en: Someone who is frail is not very strong or healthy.

words.tr: adj. 有免疫力的；免疫的；不受影响的；
words.ex: Children are immune to this disease after vaccination.
words.ex_cn: 儿童接种疫苗后对这种疾病有免疫力。
words.en: If you are immune to a particular disease, you cannot be affected by it. If you are immune to something such as criticism, it does not affect you.

words.ex: The indigenous people live in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 本土居民住在森林里。
words.en: Indigenous people or things belong to the country in which they are found, rather than coming there or being brought there from another country.

words.tr: adj. 传染性的；有感染力的；
words.ex: The virus is infectious and spreads quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒具有传染性，传播迅速。
words.en: An infectious disease can be passed from one person to another, especially through the air they breathe.

words.ex: The old man is infirm and needs help to walk.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人身体虚弱，需要帮助才能走路。
words.en: If someone is infirm, they are weak or ill, and often old.

words.ex: Birds inhabit the forest near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类居住在湖边的森林里。
words.en: If a place or region is inhabited by a group of people or a species of animal, those people or animals live there.

words.ex: Birds are inherently able to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类固有地能够飞行。
words.en: In a way that is a natural or essential part of something.

words.ex: Farmers use irrigation to water their crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用灌溉来浇灌庄稼。
words.en: Irrigation is the process of supplying water to land or crops to help growth, typically by means of channels.

words.ex: The city is at a latitude of 40 degrees north.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市位于北纬40度。
words.en: Latitude is the distance of a place north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

words.ex: Farming is his main livelihood.
words.ex_cn: 务农是他的主要生计。
words.en: A person's livelihood is the way they earn money in order to live.

words.ex: The farmer feeds his livestock every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂他的家畜。
words.en: Livestock are animals such as cattle and sheep which are kept on a farm.

words.ex: The magnitude of this decision will affect everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定的重要性会影响每个人。
words.en: Magnitude refers to the great size or extent of something, or the importance of something.

words.ex: He got malaria from a mosquito bite.
words.ex_cn: 他被蚊子叮咬后得了疟疾。
words.en: Malaria is a disease caused by a parasite that is transmitted to humans through the bites of infected mosquitoes.

words.ex: The child has malnutrition from not eating enough food.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子因为吃不够饭而营养不良。
words.en: Malnutrition is a condition that results from eating a diet in which certain nutrients are lacking, in excess (too high in intake), or in the wrong proportions.

words.ex: The marine birds fly over the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这些海鸟在海面上飞翔。
words.en: Marine is used to describe things relating to the sea or to the ships and boats which sail on it.

words.ex: Meningitis can be a life-threatening condition if not treated promptly.
words.ex_cn: 如果不及时治疗，脑膜炎可能会危及生命。
words.en: Meningitis is a serious illness in which there is inflammation of the meninges, the membranes covering the brain and spinal cord, usually caused by infection.

words.ex: The vaccine is effective against meningococcal disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种疫苗对脑膜炎球菌疾病有效。
words.en: Relating to or caused by meningococci, which are bacteria that can cause serious diseases such as meningitis and septicemia.

words.ex: Birds migrate south in winter.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在冬天迁徙到南方。
words.en: If people migrate, they move from one place to another, especially in order to find work or to live somewhere for a short time.

words.ex: He responded negatively to the proposal.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个提议持消极态度。
words.en: In a manner that is negative or pessimistic.

words.tr: adj. 神经（病）学的；神经系统的；
words.ex: The doctor checked for neurological damage after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，医生检查是否有神经学方面的损伤。
words.en: Relating to the anatomy, functions, and organic disorders of nerves and the nervous system.

words.ex: The polar bear lives in the Arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极。
words.en: relating to the North or South Pole or to the region around it; having opposite extremes or characteristics.

words.ex: The precipitation increased last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周降水增加了。
words.en: Precipitation is rain, snow, sleet, or hail — any kind of weather condition where something's falling from the sky.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: The ratio of boys to girls is 3 to 2.
words.ex_cn: 男孩与女孩的比例是3比2。
words.en: A ratio is a relationship between two numbers indicating how many times the first number contains the second.

words.ex: Heavy rain caused a large runoff into the river.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致大量径流进入河流。
words.en: Runoff refers to water, from rain or melting snow, that flows over the surface of the ground and eventually into streams, rivers, and lakes. It can also refer to a final race, election, or contest to decide a winner after an earlier one has not produced a clear result.

words.tr:
n. 避难所；庇护所；
v. 庇护；遮蔽；
words.ex: The refugees found shelter in a small building.
words.ex_cn: 难民们在一个小建筑里找到了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.ex: The scientists studied the snowpack to predict spring runoff.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们研究积雪场以预测春季径流。
words.en: A snowpack is an accumulation of snow that compresses with time and becomes compacted and hard, often found in mountainous regions.

words.tr: adj. 撒哈拉沙漠以南的非洲（大陆）的
words.ex: Sub-Saharan Africa is known for its diverse wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲以其多样的野生动物而闻名。
words.en: relating to or characteristic of the area of Africa that lies south of the Sahara Desert

words.ex: He works hard to earn his subsistence.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以维持生计。
words.en: Subsistence is the condition of just having enough food or money to stay alive.

words.ex: The subtropics are characterized by mild winters and hot summers.
words.ex_cn: 亚热带的特点是冬季温和，夏季炎热。
words.en: The subtropics are the geographical and climatic zones situated roughly between the tropics and the temperate zones.

words.tr: adj. 持久的；持续不变的； v. 维持；支撑；“sustain”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The team showed sustained effort throughout the game.
words.ex_cn: 整个比赛中，这支队伍都展现了持久的努力。
words.en: Continuing for an extended period or without interruption.

words.ex: He lives in a tropical island near the equator.
words.ex_cn: 他住在赤道附近的一个热带岛屿上。
words.en: relating to or situated in or characteristic of the tropics (the region on either side of the equator)

words.tr: phrase. 无法修复的；不可挽回的
words.ex: The old building was in a state beyond repair.
words.ex_cn: 这座老建筑已经处于无法修复的状态。
words.en: Something that is beyond repair is in such a bad condition that it cannot be fixed.

words.tr: 短语动词. 获得进入……的机会；获得对……的使用权
words.ex: He managed to gain access to the restricted area.
words.ex_cn: 他设法获得了进入限制区域的权限。
words.en: To obtain the right or opportunity to use or enter something.
